0x000.name: always_true
0x000.detail: CheckEventFlag special-cases id 0, so IF_FLAG 0x000 always takes the then lane. Placements and triggers use it for “always”.

0x001@npc/1.name: coastal_inn_story_told
0x001@npc/1.summary: Told Amos how you fell into the river
0x001@npc/1.detail: Set by Amos (npc/1) in the wake-up scene at the Coastal Inn, right after he hears the story and says the Knight was lucky to survive. Nothing in the pack tests it; it only marks progress through that scene.

0x001@npc/10.name: zed_fur_fish_merchant_greeted
0x001@npc/10.summary: The fur fish merchant from home greeted you
0x001@npc/10.detail: Set the first time you talk to the Merchant in Zed Harbor (npc/10), who recognises you from Orgo; afterwards he just hawks his fur fish. His greeting changes if Bonik's ticket scene (0x00A) has played.

0x001@npc/15.name: den_heldar_innkeeper_news_heard
0x001@npc/15.summary: Heard the Den Heldar innkeeper's latest news
0x001@npc/15.detail: Set after the innkeeper (npc/15) tells his news for the current stage: Jadik from Trisken still missing (0x090), the Trisken guest's behaviour (0x050), or the welcome back (0x092). Afterwards he skips straight to the room offer.

0x001@npc/18.name: kerple_awake_find_baby
0x001@npc/18.summary: Awake on Kerple's shore, looking for the Baby
0x001@npc/18.detail: Set when the companion wakes the Knight on the beach (npc/19, then npc/18 'I can't find $B!'). In the village square it triggers the scene where Kerpleans hold the Baby for sacrifice, which clears it.

0x001@npc/19.name: kerple_washed_ashore
0x001@npc/19.summary: Woken up after washing ashore at Kerple
0x001@npc/19.detail: Set by the 'Wake up!' scene (npc/19) before the warp to the beach; npc/18 uses it to start the sacrifice scene.

0x001@npc/21.name: trisken_attack_gargoyle_1
0x001@npc/21.detail: Set when you fight gargoyle actor 19 in chunk 270 (npc/21); it disappears. All eight (0x001-0x008) are needed before Org will fight.

0x001@npc/22.name: trisken_cafe_entry_granted
0x001@npc/22.summary: Cafe doorman agreed to let you in
0x001@npc/22.detail: Set when you accept the Trisken cafe Doorman's offer (npc/22), after paying the 3,000 entry the first time. The cafe door lets you through once and clears it; otherwise the door turns you away.

0x001@npc/27.name: garam_cave_giant_stirred
0x001@npc/27.summary: Giant's cave: the 'statue' started to move
0x001@npc/27.detail: Set in the Giant's cave (npc/27) when Ruval, taken for a statue, roars and stirs. Never tested; 0x002 follows a moment later.

0x001@npc/28.name: denvrado_shawn_view_seen
0x001@npc/28.summary: Looked at the view with Shawn
0x001@npc/28.detail: Set after Shawn (npc/28) shows you his view and the companion says you are getting close to the Baby's home. Afterwards Shawn just asks if it was a great view.

0x001@npc/30.name: gods_tower_baby_taken
0x001@npc/30.detail: Set in the God's Tower summit scene (npc/30) as the Baby runs to its mother and is grabbed. Never tested; one of many step markers in that scene.

0x001@npc/34.name: jungo_darkbeat_talked
0x001@npc/34.summary: Talked to Darkbeat at his Jungo home
0x001@npc/34.detail: Set by Darkbeat in Jungo (npc/35). On the port (npc/34) Aki then asks you to play hide and seek and Pengie complains about the heat; it is one of the four boarding conditions checked by Bonik's scene.

0x001@npc/35.name: jungo_darkbeat_home_talk
0x001@npc/35.summary: Darkbeat told you about the orphans and Karmine
0x001@npc/35.detail: Set the first time you talk to Darkbeat in his Jungo home (npc/35). Afterwards he wishes you a safe journey, Ibkee barks happily and the children change their lines. One of the boarding conditions.

0x001@npc/37.name: barrier_stones_handed_over
0x001@npc/37.summary: Betrayal scene: Kalkanor's stones went to Karmine
0x001@npc/37.detail: Set in the betrayal scene (npc/37) as the stones are handed to Karmine. Never tested.

0x001@npc/39.name: zed_attack_governor_pleaded
0x001@npc/39.summary: The Governor begged for help (kept through the wipe)
0x001@npc/39.detail: Tested by Bosmie's fight start in Zed Harbor (npc/39): if set it is set again after wipe_scratch, so the Governor (npc/48) later admits his promised reward.

0x001@npc/42.name: zephyr_storm_captain_talked
0x001@npc/42.summary: Storm voyage: the Captain warned of the storm
0x001@npc/42.detail: Set the first time you talk to the Captain on the Jungo-Trisken voyage (npc/42, 0x08F). With 0x002 and 0x003 (or 0x027) he sends you to your cabin.

0x001@npc/44.name: north_tower_guards_fought
0x001@npc/44.summary: Fought Karmine's two monsters guarding the captives
0x001@npc/44.detail: Set (with 0x00E) as the battle with the red and blue monsters starts in the North Tower (npc/44). It removes the monsters and brings out the freed Den Heldar captives, and the trigger then plays the rescue aftermath that sets 0x090.

0x001@npc/48.name: zed_governor_begged_for_help
0x001@npc/48.summary: The Governor begged you to save the city
0x001@npc/48.detail: Set when the Governor (npc/48) pleads for help during the Cult attack (0x0E6). The Bosmie fight (npc/39) keeps it through its scratch wipe; afterwards the Governor grudgingly admits the reward he offered.

0x001@npc/6.name: orgo_mary_said_good_morning
0x001@npc/6.summary: Mary said good morning and sent you to the Mayor
0x001@npc/6.detail: Set when Mary (npc/6) greets the late-waking Knight on day one; afterwards she just hurries you to the Mayor.

0x001@npc/9.name: picard_read_book_of_legends
0x001@npc/9.summary: Read the Book of Legends in Picard's library
0x001@npc/9.detail: Set when you read the Book of Legends (npc/9) before 0x0A5. Once all four books (0x001-0x004) are read, 0x009 is set.

0x002@npc/1.name: coastal_inn_bonik_introduced
0x002@npc/1.summary: Bonik burst in and introduced himself
0x002@npc/1.detail: Set mid-way through the Coastal Inn wake-up scene (npc/1), after the loud merchant Bonik introduces himself. Never tested; a scene progress marker only.

0x002@npc/10.name: zed_tickets_sold_out
0x002@npc/10.summary: The last ship tickets are sold out
0x002@npc/10.detail: Set by Bonik's scene in the ticket office (npc/11). On the docks (npc/10) the Sailor then says no tickets are left, or, once the Governor's offer stands (0x004), wishes you luck with the emerald.

0x002@npc/11.name: zed_bonik_bought_last_tickets
0x002@npc/11.summary: Bonik's customer bought the last tickets
0x002@npc/11.detail: Set at the end of Bonik's ticket-office scene (npc/11). The Ticket Agent then says none are left; with 0x003 it also sets 0x025, which opens the Governor's offer.

0x002@npc/18.name: kerple_saw_baby_captive
0x002@npc/18.summary: Saw the Kerpleans holding the Baby
0x002@npc/18.detail: Set mid-way through the sacrifice scene in Kerple's square (npc/18) when the companion spots the captive Baby. Never tested.

0x002@npc/21.name: trisken_attack_gargoyle_2
0x002@npc/21.detail: Set when you fight gargoyle actor 20 in chunk 272 (npc/21); it disappears. The Flower Girl then thanks you. All eight (0x001-0x008) are needed before Org will fight.

0x002@npc/22.name: trisken_cafe_owe_entry
0x002@npc/22.summary: Agreed to the cafe deal but couldn't pay
0x002@npc/22.detail: Set when you say yes to the Doorman's 3,000 cafe pitch (npc/22). If you could not pay, next time he asks again if you have the money (and clears it) or tells you off.

0x002@npc/27.name: garam_cave_ruval_fought
0x002@npc/27.summary: Fought Ruval, the Giant in the cave
0x002@npc/27.detail: Set as the Ruval battle starts (npc/27). Places Ann and two extra actors, and the cave trigger then replays Ruval's script for the scene where Ann begs you to stop (sets 0x003).

0x002@npc/28.name: denvrado_neophyte_joined
0x002@npc/28.summary: Told the Neophyte you came to study with Aruvin
0x002@npc/28.detail: Set when you answer yes to the Neophyte (npc/28) and he welcomes you 'to the gang'; afterwards he laments his 40 years of study.

0x002@npc/3.name: isten_marco_rescued_1
0x002@npc/3.summary: Marco rescue scene: Marco came round
0x002@npc/3.detail: Set in the scene after Marco is freed (npc/3, chunk 378, starts with 0x0A7) once Marco asks what happened to him. Never tested; scene step marker.

0x002@npc/30.name: gods_tower_baby_says_momma
0x002@npc/30.summary: Summit: the Baby recognised its mother
0x002@npc/30.detail: Set in the summit scene (npc/30) when the Baby cries 'Momma!'. Never tested.

0x002@npc/34.name: jungo_bonik_shop_shown
0x002@npc/34.summary: Bonik showed off his new shop
0x002@npc/34.detail: Set mid-way through Bonik's scene on the Jungo port (npc/34), just after 0x003. Never tested.

0x002@npc/39.name: zed_attack_gargoyle_sailor
0x002@npc/39.summary: Beat the gargoyle attacking the Sailor
0x002@npc/39.detail: Set when you fight the gargoyle on the docks (npc/39, actor 15) after 0x008. It disappears and the Sailor thanks you for saving his life. One of four (0x002-0x005) that make 0x009.

0x002@npc/42.name: zephyr_storm_clouds_seen
0x002@npc/42.summary: Storm voyage: a sailor pointed out the storm clouds
0x002@npc/42.detail: Set the first time the deck Sailor (npc/42) shows you the storm clouds on the second voyage; with 0x001 and 0x003 he sends you below.

0x002@npc/44.name: north_tower_rescue_step_1
0x002@npc/44.detail: Set in the North Tower rescue aftermath (npc/44) just before 0x090 and a scratch wipe, so it is cleared at once. Never tested.

0x002@npc/49.name: final_karmine_cursed_by_xizan
0x002@npc/49.summary: Karmine said Xizan turned him into a monster
0x002@npc/49.detail: Set when Karmine, back as a monster, blames the party because Xizan cursed him after their battle (npc/49); afterwards Darkbeat realises why his sister is still not human.

0x002@npc/6.name: orgo_mary_errand_gift
0x002@npc/6.summary: Mary heard about the errand and gave you a gift
0x002@npc/6.detail: Set when Mary (npc/6) hears you are going to San Claria and gives item 1; afterwards she promises a warm meal and the farmers switch to their second lines. The Knight's-house morning scene (npc/7) keeps it through its scratch wipe.

0x002@npc/7.name: orgo_mary_gift_kept
0x002@npc/7.summary: Mary's errand gift was received (kept through the wipe)
0x002@npc/7.detail: Tested by the Knight's-house morning scene (npc/7): if set, it is set again right after wipe_scratch, so Mary's gift (0x002 in npc/6) survives the reset.

0x002@npc/9.name: picard_read_prophecy_book
0x002@npc/9.summary: Read the Prophecy Book in Picard's library
0x002@npc/9.detail: Set when you read the Prophecy Book (npc/9) before 0x0A5; one of the four books that together set 0x009.

0x003@npc/1.name: coastal_inn_hosts_said_goodnight
0x003@npc/1.summary: Amos and Martha went to bed
0x003@npc/1.detail: Set in the Coastal Inn wake-up scene (npc/1) when Amos and Martha say good night. If the scene stops here, talking to Amos again only gives the 'You're not tired?' line and sets 0x004.

0x003@npc/10.name: zed_emerald_gossip_cleared
0x003@npc/10.summary: Heard the emerald gossip (cleared at the docks)
0x003@npc/10.detail: In npc/10 it is only cleared, by Kalkanor's docks scene. It is set by the cafe customers in npc/11 when you overhear that the Governor wants the Beast's emerald.

0x003@npc/11.name: zed_heard_governor_emerald
0x003@npc/11.summary: Heard the Governor wants the Beast's emerald
0x003@npc/11.detail: Set when you overhear cafe customers in Zed Harbor (npc/11) gossip that the Governor will give anything for the emerald guarded by the Beast. With 0x002 it sets 0x025. Kalkanor's docks scene (npc/10) clears it.

0x003@npc/14.name: den_heldar_detective_talked
0x003@npc/14.summary: Heard Detective Longnose's speech this visit
0x003@npc/14.detail: Set the first time you talk to Detective Longnose (npc/14) at each story stage (before 0x090, after 0x090/0x091/0x092, and in the 0x0E6 crisis, where he also hands over item 1003). Afterwards he only gives his short line until scratch is wiped.

0x003@npc/18.name: kerple_sacrifice_scene_seen
0x003@npc/18.summary: Kerpleans said the Baby will be sacrificed
0x003@npc/18.detail: Set at the end of the sacrifice scene (npc/18). Afterwards the Kerpleans only repeat 'Pig. Sacrifice.' It is also one of the four talks (with 0x004-0x006) the companion needs before entering Yugonga's shrine.

0x003@npc/21.name: trisken_attack_gargoyle_3
0x003@npc/21.detail: Set when you fight gargoyle actor 21 in chunk 272 (npc/21); it disappears. The Old Man then says there are none left nearby. All eight (0x001-0x008) are needed before Org will fight.

0x003@npc/22.name: trisken_inn_lady_parade_talk
0x003@npc/22.detail: Set the first time you talk to the inn Lady (npc/22) after 0x091; afterwards she just advertises the inn.

0x003@npc/27.name: garam_cave_ann_defends_ruval
0x003@npc/27.summary: Ann stopped the fight: Ruval is her friend
0x003@npc/27.detail: Set when Ann cries 'Stop hurting my friend!' (npc/27). Afterwards Ann asks you not to hurt Ruval, Kalkanor's party stands by outside, and the cave zones set 0x00B or 0x00C to start their entrance.

0x003@npc/28.name: denvrado_pilgrim_talked
0x003@npc/28.summary: Talked to the sick pilgrim heading to Aruvin
0x003@npc/28.detail: Set the first time you talk to the Old Man pilgrim (npc/28); afterwards he hopes to reach the sanctuary safely.

0x003@npc/3.name: isten_marco_rescued_2
0x003@npc/3.summary: Marco rescue scene: Carmen reunited with Marco
0x003@npc/3.detail: Set in the Marco rescue scene (npc/3) after Carmen runs to Marco. Never tested.

0x003@npc/30.name: gods_tower_baby_runs_off
0x003@npc/30.summary: Summit: the Baby ran towards its mother
0x003@npc/30.detail: Set in the summit scene (npc/30) when the Baby ignores the warning and goes to its mother. Never tested.

0x003@npc/34.name: jungo_bonik_shop_opened
0x003@npc/34.summary: Bonik's Jungo shop opening scene has played
0x003@npc/34.detail: Set by Bonik's 'I finally have my own shop!' scene on the port (npc/34); he then leaves for his shop. One of the conditions (with 0x001, 0x00B and item 1042) for boarding (0x00C).

0x003@npc/35.name: jungo_bonik_shop_opened_in
0x003@npc/35.summary: Bonik's shop opening scene has played
0x003@npc/35.detail: Set by Bonik's port scene (npc/34). In the interiors (npc/35) it is one of the boarding conditions checked after each task.

0x003@npc/37.name: barrier_betrayal_seen
0x003@npc/37.summary: Saw Gwinladin betray Kalkanor to Karmine
0x003@npc/37.detail: Set at the end of the scene where Gwinladin is unmasked as Glor and cursed (npc/37). Repositions Kalkanor and Ramal, and the trigger then starts the first battle (0x004).

0x003@npc/39.name: zed_attack_gargoyle_jedro
0x003@npc/39.detail: Set when you fight the gargoyle near Jedro (npc/39, actor 14); Jedro then says it was scary. One of the four gargoyles.

0x003@npc/42.name: zephyr_storm_go_below
0x003@npc/42.summary: Storm voyage: time to go to the cabin
0x003@npc/42.detail: Set once the seasick passengers have been talked to (0x004-0x006) and the chest item 1031 found, or via 0x027 (npc/42). The deck and cabin triggers then play the Baby's seasickness and the storm that wrecks the ship.

0x003@npc/44.name: north_tower_rescue_step_2
0x003@npc/44.summary: Rescue aftermath: a captive thanked you
0x003@npc/44.detail: Set in the North Tower rescue aftermath (npc/44) just before 0x090 and a scratch wipe, so it is cleared at once. Never tested.

0x003@npc/49.name: final_karmine_spotted
0x003@npc/49.summary: Spotted Karmine at the final battle
0x003@npc/49.detail: Set when the companion cries 'It's Karmine!' (npc/49); talking to Darkbeat again then plays Karmine's accusation (0x002).

0x003@npc/6.name: orgo_algo_pep_talk
0x003@npc/6.summary: Algo gave his brave-man talk about San Claria
0x003@npc/6.detail: Set the first time Algo (npc/6) hears you are going to San Claria; he only gives the speech once.

0x003@npc/9.name: picard_read_book_of_seals
0x003@npc/9.summary: Read the Book of Seals in Picard's library
0x003@npc/9.detail: Set when you read the Book of Seals (npc/9) before 0x0A5; one of the four books that together set 0x009.

0x004@npc/1.name: coastal_inn_night
0x004@npc/1.summary: Night at the Coastal Inn: everyone has gone to bed
0x004@npc/1.detail: Set when the Knight goes to sleep at the end of the Coastal Inn wake-up scene (npc/1). While set, Amos and Martha stand in their night spots, Bonik appears downstairs ('Can't sleep?') and the chunk 342 trigger plays the sleepless-night line.

0x004@npc/10.name: zed_governor_wants_emerald
0x004@npc/10.summary: The Governor offered tickets for the Beast Emerald
0x004@npc/10.detail: Set by the Governor (npc/48). On the streets (npc/10) it brings Kalkanor's party to the docks and the trigger plays their scene (sets 0x005); the Sailor mentions the Governor's trade. Cleared when you hand the Governor the stone.

0x004@npc/14.name: den_heldar_historian_talked
0x004@npc/14.summary: Heard the Historian's news this visit
0x004@npc/14.detail: Set after the Historian (npc/14) gives his stage speech about the North Tower ruins (after 0x090/0x091, or 0x092); afterwards he only repeats his closing line.

0x004@npc/18.name: kerple_chief_heard_shrine
0x004@npc/18.detail: Set by the Chief in his hut (npc/19). Tested at the shrine front (npc/18) as one of the four talks needed before the companion leads you in.

0x004@npc/19.name: kerple_chief_talked
0x004@npc/19.summary: Chief explained the sacrifice to the evil god
0x004@npc/19.detail: Set when the Chief (npc/19) says they must make sacrifice to the god in the shrine. With 0x005 and 0x006 it adds the 'get rid of the monster' objective.

0x004@npc/21.name: trisken_attack_gargoyle_4
0x004@npc/21.detail: Set when you fight gargoyle actor 22 in chunk 270 (npc/21); it disappears. All eight (0x001-0x008) are needed before Org will fight.

0x004@npc/22.name: trisken_flower_girl_asked
0x004@npc/22.summary: Flower Girl has offered you a rose
0x004@npc/22.detail: Set the first time the Flower Girl (npc/22) asks if you want a 300-ruby rose (before 0x090); next time she is surprised you want to buy one.

0x004@npc/27.name: garam_cave_kalkanor_arrived
0x004@npc/27.summary: Kalkanor's party burst into the Giant's cave
0x004@npc/27.detail: Set at the start of the scene where Kalkanor, Ramal and Gwinladin arrive and paralyse you (npc/27); it stops that trigger from repeating.

0x004@npc/28.name: denvrado_wife_told_zombie
0x004@npc/28.summary: Told the Wife where her zombie husband is
0x004@npc/28.detail: Set when the Wife (npc/28) asks about her green husband after you have met the zombie (0x006); afterwards she defends zombies.

0x004@npc/3.name: isten_marco_rescued_3
0x004@npc/3.summary: Marco rescue scene: the wedding is back on
0x004@npc/3.detail: Set in the Marco rescue scene (npc/3) when Carmen says they can finally have the wedding. Never tested.

0x004@npc/30.name: gods_tower_xizan_summoned
0x004@npc/30.summary: Summit: Karmine called forth Xizan; Darkbeat arrives
0x004@npc/30.detail: Set in the summit scene (npc/30) right after Karmine orders Xizan to awaken. It places Darkbeat and Ibkee in the chamber.

0x004@npc/37.name: barrier_first_battle
0x004@npc/37.summary: Fought the first battle at the barrier site
0x004@npc/37.detail: Set as the first battle after the betrayal starts (npc/37). Moves the actors; talking to Ramal's marker next starts the second battle (0x005/0x006).

0x004@npc/39.name: zed_attack_gargoyle_lady
0x004@npc/39.summary: Beat the gargoyle attacking the Lady
0x004@npc/39.detail: Set when you fight the gargoyle near the Lady (npc/39, actor 16); she then tells you they appeared out of nowhere. One of the four gargoyles.

0x004@npc/4.name: san_claria_letter_delivered
0x004@npc/4.summary: Delivered the Orgo Mayor's letter in San Claria
0x004@npc/4.detail: Set by San Claria's Mayor (npc/5) when you hand him the letter. Outside (npc/4) Jiggy then mentions a strange animal heading for Orgo and the Boy brags about his biggest fur fish.

0x004@npc/42.name: zephyr_storm_traveler_talked
0x004@npc/42.summary: Storm voyage: the Traveler complained of the rolling
0x004@npc/42.detail: Set when you talk to the Traveler on the storm voyage (npc/42). One of the three passenger talks (0x004-0x006) needed before going below.

0x004@npc/44.name: north_tower_rescue_step_3
0x004@npc/44.summary: Rescue aftermath: the Mayor learned Gamella sent you
0x004@npc/44.detail: Set in the North Tower rescue aftermath (npc/44) just before 0x090 and a scratch wipe, so it is cleared at once. Never tested.

0x004@npc/48.name: zed_governor_emerald_offer
0x004@npc/48.summary: The Governor offered tickets for the Beast Emerald
0x004@npc/48.detail: Set by the Governor (npc/48) once 0x025 is set: he will give anything for the Beast Emerald (first time adds the Kuldo objective). Cleared when Kalkanor's scene ends and he hands over the tickets.

0x004@npc/5.name: san_claria_errand_done
0x004@npc/5.summary: Errand done: Mayor Kalan read the Orgo letter
0x004@npc/5.detail: Set by Mayor Kalan (npc/5) when you hand over the Orgo Mayor's letter (he takes item 500 and clears 0x020); he then only asks you to cheer your mayor up. The innkeeper also sets it, with 0x097, when you sleep there after the baby was sent away (0x096), which sends you back to Orgo at night.

0x004@npc/6.name: orgo_night_return
0x004@npc/6.summary: Evening back in Orgo: villagers are indoors
0x004@npc/6.detail: Set in San Claria (npc/5) when the errand is done, or by going to bed after the baby was sent away. While set every Orgo villager is absent and the chunk 78 trigger plays the stranger-in-light scene that hands over the baby.

0x004@npc/7.name: orgo_night_mayor_talk
0x004@npc/7.summary: Night in Orgo: the baby is to be explained to the Mayor
0x004@npc/7.detail: Set in San Claria when the errand is done (npc/5). In the Mayor's house (npc/7) the Mayor doubts the man of light and orders the monster taken to the cave tomorrow (sets 0x01A); next morning the house scene says it was 'just an illusion', sets 0x081 and wipes scratch.

0x004@npc/9.name: picard_read_holy_armor_book
0x004@npc/9.summary: Read the Book of Holy Armor in Picard's library
0x004@npc/9.detail: Set when you read the Book of Holy Armor (npc/9) before 0x0A5, together with 0x0F2 and the world-map pins; one of the four books that together set 0x009.

0x005@npc/1.name: coastal_inn_cat_petted
0x005@npc/1.summary: Petted one of the inn's cats
0x005@npc/1.detail: Set the first time you talk to a cat at the Coastal Inn (npc/1, 'What a cute kitty cat!'). Afterwards the cats only meow.

0x005@npc/10.name: zed_met_kalkanors_party
0x005@npc/10.summary: Met Kalkanor's party on the docks
0x005@npc/10.detail: Set by the docks scene (npc/10) where Gwinladin sneers at the boy and his pig and says they only care about the Kuldo Emerald; also sets 0x012 and clears 0x003. Afterwards the party leaves and the Informer and cafe customers talk about Kuldo.

0x005@npc/11.name: zed_kuldo_gossip
0x005@npc/11.summary: Kalkanor's party has headed for Kuldo
0x005@npc/11.detail: Set by Kalkanor's docks scene (npc/10). The cafe customers in npc/11 then only say Kuldo is a long way past the desert.

0x005@npc/18.name: kerple_tribesman_heard_shrine
0x005@npc/18.summary: Kerplean told of the monster (shrine check)
0x005@npc/18.detail: Set by a Kerplean in the huts (npc/19). Tested at the shrine front (npc/18) as one of the four talks.

0x005@npc/19.name: kerple_monster_talk
0x005@npc/19.summary: Kerplean told of the monster in the shrine
0x005@npc/19.detail: Set when a Kerplean (npc/19, actor 4) says an evil monster is in the shrine; one of the three hut talks.

0x005@npc/2.name: isten_wedding_late_guests
0x005@npc/2.summary: Wedding: the late arrivals interrupted the vows
0x005@npc/2.detail: Set in Marco and Carmen's wedding ceremony (npc/2) when latecomers burst in during the vows. Never tested; a scene progress marker.

0x005@npc/21.name: trisken_attack_gargoyle_5
0x005@npc/21.detail: Set when you fight gargoyle actor 23 in chunk 270 (npc/21); it disappears. All eight (0x001-0x008) are needed before Org will fight.

0x005@npc/22.name: trisken_old_man_eastern_pass
0x005@npc/22.summary: Old Man told you about the Eastern Pass gate
0x005@npc/22.detail: Set the first time the Old Man (npc/22) says the road leads to the closed Eastern Pass gate; afterwards he asks whether the guards let you through (0x05A changes his answer).

0x005@npc/28.name: denvrado_monk_told_zombie
0x005@npc/28.summary: Told the Monk where the zombie is
0x005@npc/28.detail: Set when the Monk (npc/28) asks about the zombie after you met it (0x006); he walks off and stands by the zombie, then grudgingly admits it has done no harm.

0x005@npc/30.name: gods_tower_karmine_fought
0x005@npc/30.detail: Set as the first Karmine battle starts (npc/30). Moves the actors, and the summit trigger then plays Darkbeat's demand to turn his sister back, which ends in the second battle (0x006).

0x005@npc/34.name: jungo_husband_home
0x005@npc/34.summary: The sailor husband came home to his wife
0x005@npc/34.detail: Set by the 'Honey! I'm home!' scene on the Jungo port (npc/34). It removes the husband's scene actors and lets the next zone play the companion's 'nice, happy couple' line (0x00A).

0x005@npc/37.name: barrier_second_battle_a
0x005@npc/37.summary: Second battle at the barrier site begun
0x005@npc/37.detail: Set together with 0x006 before the second battle (npc/37). Only a placement tests it, which 0x003 already satisfies.

0x005@npc/39.name: zed_attack_gargoyle_four
0x005@npc/39.summary: Beat the fourth gargoyle in the streets
0x005@npc/39.detail: Set when you fight the gargoyle actor 17 (npc/39); it disappears and a nearby man stops asking for help. One of the four gargoyles.

0x005@npc/4.name: san_claria_net_fisher_talked
0x005@npc/4.detail: Set the first time you talk to the fisher mending nets (npc/4); afterwards he says he is too busy.

0x005@npc/41.name: rogo_kuldo_trip_started
0x005@npc/41.summary: On the way to Kuldo after the Zed Harbor docks scene
0x005@npc/41.detail: Set in Zed Harbor when Kalkanor's party heads for Kuldo (npc/10). At Rogo's (npc/41) it opens the way to the dig, moves Rogo and makes him mistake you for his late courier Jedro.

0x005@npc/42.name: zephyr_storm_lady_talked
0x005@npc/42.summary: Storm voyage: the seasick Lady talked
0x005@npc/42.detail: Set when you talk to the seasick Lady on the storm voyage (npc/42). One of the three passenger talks.

0x005@npc/44.name: north_tower_rescue_step_4
0x005@npc/44.summary: Rescue aftermath: told the Trisken man is still inside
0x005@npc/44.detail: Set in the North Tower rescue aftermath (npc/44) just before 0x090 and a scratch wipe, so it is cleared at once. Never tested.

0x005@npc/49.name: final_darkbeat_takes_karmine
0x005@npc/49.summary: Darkbeat and Ibkee will hold off Karmine
0x005@npc/49.detail: Set when Darkbeat says they will take care of Karmine while you stop Xizan (npc/49); afterwards Karmine just gloats that he will never die.

0x005@npc/9.name: picard_companions_found
0x005@npc/9.summary: Found the companions playing in the side room
0x005@npc/9.detail: Set by the reunion scene in Picard's side room (npc/9, chunk 409). Afterwards the Picardians greet you normally, the side-room trigger stops, and Darkbeat asks his favour and hands over the Warp Gate key (0x085).

0x006@npc/1.name: coastal_inn_morning_after_bonik
0x006@npc/1.summary: Next morning at the Coastal Inn; Bonik has left
0x006@npc/1.detail: Set by Bonik's late-night talk (npc/1) just before the Knight sleeps. While set Bonik is gone, the cats move, and Amos asks if Bonik woke you, then hands over Bonik's magic map (sets 0x024).

0x006@npc/11.name: zed_inn_calm_again
0x006@npc/11.summary: Zed Harbor innkeeper gives his calmer crisis offer
0x006@npc/11.detail: Only tested by the Zed Harbor innkeeper (npc/11) while 0x0E6 is set: set means he gives his 'world turned upside down' offer instead of grumbling about a room at a time like this. No pack sets it in Zed Harbor.

0x006@npc/13.name: carmarthen_side_exit_used
0x006@npc/13.summary: Left Carmarthen interiors by the side exit
0x006@npc/13.detail: Set by an exit actor in npc/13 (actor 37) just before it warps you out to chunk 121. Never tested.

0x006@npc/18.name: kerple_deep_shrine_heard
0x006@npc/18.summary: Kerplean described the deep shrine (shrine check)
0x006@npc/18.detail: Set by a Kerplean in the huts (npc/19). Tested at the shrine front (npc/18) as one of the four talks.

0x006@npc/19.name: kerple_deep_shrine_talk
0x006@npc/19.detail: Set when a Kerplean (npc/19, actor 10) describes the monster deep in the shrine; one of the three hut talks.

0x006@npc/2.name: isten_wedding_no_objection
0x006@npc/2.summary: Wedding: nobody objected to the marriage
0x006@npc/2.detail: Set in the wedding ceremony (npc/2) after the party says they have no objection, just before Marco and Carmen are declared husband and wife (0x06A). Never tested.

0x006@npc/21.name: trisken_attack_gargoyle_6
0x006@npc/21.detail: Set when you fight gargoyle actor 24 in chunk 270 (npc/21); it disappears. All eight (0x001-0x008) are needed before Org will fight.

0x006@npc/28.name: denvrado_zombie_met
0x006@npc/28.summary: Met the zombie behind the house
0x006@npc/28.detail: Set the first time you talk to the Zombie (npc/28, 'Brains!'). Lets you tell the Wife (0x004) and the Monk (0x005) where he is.

0x006@npc/30.name: gods_tower_karmine_fought_again
0x006@npc/30.summary: Summit: fought Karmine a second time
0x006@npc/30.detail: Set before the second Karmine battle (npc/30). Afterwards the summit trigger plays Karmine's defeat, where he calls on Xizan and sets 0x0E6.

0x006@npc/34.name: jungo_innkeeper_remark
0x006@npc/34.summary: Innkeeper remarked on the reunited couple
0x006@npc/34.detail: Cleared and then set again by the Jungo Innkeeper's remark about the husband and wife (npc/34). Never tested.

0x006@npc/37.name: barrier_second_battle
0x006@npc/37.summary: Fought the second battle; Glor is turning
0x006@npc/37.detail: Set before the second battle (npc/37). Moves the party, and the next talk plays the cursed Glor's last words and the final battle (0x007).

0x006@npc/4.name: san_claria_boat_fisher_talked
0x006@npc/4.detail: Set the first time you talk to the second fisher (npc/4) about the poor fur fish catch; afterwards he offers to lend his rowboat.

0x006@npc/41.name: rogo_artifact_for_galik
0x006@npc/41.summary: Rogo gave you the artifact to take to Galik
0x006@npc/41.detail: Set when Rogo, thinking you are Jedro, hands over the ancient artifact for Galik in Carmarthen (npc/41). He then nags you to deliver it, and the dig zones set 0x013.

0x006@npc/42.name: zephyr_storm_passenger_talked
0x006@npc/42.summary: Storm voyage: the sick Passenger talked
0x006@npc/42.detail: Set in the sick Passenger's short scene on the storm voyage (npc/42). One of the three passenger talks.

0x006@npc/9.name: picard_darkbeat_celestia_talk
0x006@npc/9.summary: Darkbeat explained the Baby is Celestia's child
0x006@npc/9.detail: Set the first time you talk to Darkbeat in Picard (npc/9) before 0x085; he then only sighs about Karmine and the Holy Armor until the companions are found.

0x007@npc/12.name: carmarthen_back_from_kuldo
0x007@npc/12.detail: Set in the Kuldo Ruins (npc/45) when Kalkanor's party has taken the emerald. In Carmarthen (npc/12) the villagers then talk about your Kuldo trip and Kalkanor's gem, and Galik's door opens.

0x007@npc/13.name: carmarthen_galik_home
0x007@npc/13.summary: Back from Kuldo: Galik is home
0x007@npc/13.detail: Set in the Kuldo Ruins (npc/45). In Carmarthen's interiors (npc/13) it places Galik in his house (he is also there from chapter 2 on).

0x007@npc/14.name: den_heldar_sneeze_toggle
0x007@npc/14.summary: Sneezing citizen: handkerchief line is next
0x007@npc/14.detail: Toggle used by a sneezing Citizen in Den Heldar (npc/14) after 0x092 and 0x052: one talk sets it, the next asks to borrow a handkerchief and clears it.

0x007@npc/18.name: kerple_yugonga_beaten
0x007@npc/18.summary: Yugonga has been fought; the Baby is freed
0x007@npc/18.detail: Set when the Yugonga fight starts in the shrine (npc/19). In npc/18 the Kerpleans move to the shrine, the waiting Kerplean leaves, the table where the Baby was tied can be searched, and the shrine-front trigger plays the Chief's release scene.

0x007@npc/19.name: kerple_yugonga_fought
0x007@npc/19.detail: Set as the Yugonga fight begins (npc/19). Yugonga and his marker disappear, the shrine trigger stops, villagers give thanks and the Chief gives the flute.

0x007@npc/2.name: isten_wedding_walk_1
0x007@npc/2.detail: Set in the wedding procession scene (npc/2, after 0x06A) after a guest compliments Carmen's dress. One of three step markers (0x007-0x009); never tested.

0x007@npc/21.name: trisken_attack_gargoyle_7
0x007@npc/21.detail: Set when you fight gargoyle actor 25 in chunk 271 (npc/21); it disappears. The Royal Guard then agrees to hold the castle while you clear the city. All eight (0x001-0x008) are needed before Org will fight.

0x007@npc/23.name: trisken_maris_talked
0x007@npc/23.summary: Maris has told you about her husband
0x007@npc/23.detail: Set the first time you talk to Maris (npc/23) at each stage: before 0x091 she says her husband went off on a secret trip and she hired a man with a dinosaur; after 0x091 she thanks you for saving him. Afterwards she uses her short line.

0x007@npc/27.name: garam_cave_ann_protests
0x007@npc/27.summary: Ann protested that Ruval isn't bad
0x007@npc/27.detail: Set in Kalkanor's arrival scene (npc/27) as Ann protests, just before the paralysis spell. Never tested.

0x007@npc/28.name: denvrado_singer_fan_talked
0x007@npc/28.detail: Set the first time you talk to the Woman listening to the Singer (npc/28); afterwards she raves about his voice.

0x007@npc/30.name: gods_tower_mother_cries_out
0x007@npc/30.summary: Summit aftermath: the Baby's mother cried out
0x007@npc/30.detail: Set (with 0x008) at the start of the post-0x0E6 summit scene in npc/30. Never tested.

0x007@npc/34.name: jungo_husband_greeting
0x007@npc/34.summary: Homecoming scene: husband greeted his wife
0x007@npc/34.detail: Set at the start of the husband's homecoming scene on the Jungo port (npc/34). Never tested.

0x007@npc/37.name: barrier_glor_fought
0x007@npc/37.detail: Set before the last battle at the barrier site (npc/37). The trigger then plays the wounded Ramal asking you to warn Trisken, which sets 0x092 and wipes scratch.

0x007@npc/39.name: zed_attack_arrived
0x007@npc/39.summary: Arrived to find Zed Harbor under Cult attack
0x007@npc/39.detail: Set by the arrival trigger in Zed Harbor (npc/39) after a scratch wipe, with 0x0F0/0x0EF and the 'city is under attack' objective. Arms the zone triggers and the companion's docks remarks.

0x007@npc/4.name: san_claria_boy_told_mayor_house
0x007@npc/4.summary: Boy told you where Mayor Kalan lives
0x007@npc/4.detail: Set when the Boy (npc/4) points you to Mayor Kalan's big house while you still carry the letter (item 500); afterwards he goes back to his glasses story.

0x007@npc/41.name: rogo_back_from_kuldo
0x007@npc/41.summary: Back from the Kuldo Ruins: the salesman has gone
0x007@npc/41.detail: Set in the Kuldo Ruins (npc/45). At Rogo's (npc/41) only a placement tests it: the travelling salesman is gone until Galik has the artifact (0x008).

0x007@npc/42.name: zephyr_storm_baby_seasick
0x007@npc/42.summary: Storm voyage: the Baby got seasick
0x007@npc/42.detail: Set by the cabin scene where the Baby is about to throw up (npc/42). Moves the deck sailors; the next trigger plays 'What a storm!', wipes scratch and warps you, shipwrecked, to Kerple.

0x007@npc/44.name: north_tower_false_captive_fought
0x007@npc/44.summary: Fought the 'Art thou worthy?' trial in the tower
0x007@npc/44.detail: Set when the figure posing as the trapped Triskenian challenges you (npc/44) before the battle. Places Jadik and his chest, and the trigger then plays Jadik's thanks and the Solomon's Ring find (sets 0x091).

0x007@npc/45.name: kuldo_emerald_taken
0x007@npc/45.summary: Kalkanor's party took the emerald; head back to Galik
0x007@npc/45.detail: Set in the Kuldo Ruins (npc/45) when the companion realises they took the emerald and suggests seeing Galik, then Zed Harbor. Stops the ruins trigger and changes who stands at the altar; Carmarthen (npc/12, npc/13) and Rogo (npc/41) react to it too.

0x007@npc/9.name: picard_library_seen
0x007@npc/9.summary: Saw the library before getting the gate key
0x007@npc/9.detail: Set when the companion marvels at all the books (npc/9) before 0x085. The library trigger then sends Darkbeat to say you haven't checked all the books yet.

0x008@npc/10.name: zed_back_from_carmarthen
0x008@npc/10.summary: Back from Galik: the ship has arrived
0x008@npc/10.detail: Set by Galik in Carmarthen (npc/13) when he identifies the warp gate key and you head back to Zed Harbor. In npc/10 the Informer says the ship has arrived and the Sailor takes your tickets once 0x009 is also set (sets 0x016).

0x008@npc/13.name: carmarthen_galik_key_explained
0x008@npc/13.summary: Galik identified the broken warp gate key
0x008@npc/13.detail: Set when you hand Galik the artifact from Rogo (npc/13) and he explains warp gate keys; objective: back to Zed Harbor. Zed Harbor then reacts to it as 0x008 (npc/10, npc/48).

0x008@npc/18.name: kerple_flute_given
0x008@npc/18.detail: Stops the shrine-front trigger in npc/18. It is set by the Chief (npc/19) only together with 0x086 and an immediate scratch wipe, so in practice 0x086 does this job.

0x008@npc/19.name: kerple_flute_received
0x008@npc/19.detail: Set by the Chief (npc/19) with 0x086 right before wipe_scratch, so it is cleared at once. Effectively unused.

0x008@npc/2.name: isten_wedding_walk_2
0x008@npc/2.detail: Set in the wedding procession scene (npc/2) after a guest compliments Marco. Never tested.

0x008@npc/21.name: trisken_attack_gargoyle_8
0x008@npc/21.detail: Set when you fight gargoyle actor 26 in chunk 272 (npc/21); it disappears. All eight (0x001-0x008) are needed before Org will fight.

0x008@npc/24.name: castle_party_purse_stolen
0x008@npc/24.summary: Party: the Noblewoman's purse has been stolen
0x008@npc/24.detail: Set once you have talked to all five party guests (0x009-0x00D) in the castle hall (npc/24); the King's scene then cries thief and seals the exits. While set the guests react to the theft and the Baby can sniff out the thief.

0x008@npc/27.name: garam_cave_left_to_gwinladin
0x008@npc/27.detail: Set at the end of Kalkanor's arrival scene (npc/27) before the battle. Moves the party and Ann, and the cave trigger then plays Gwinladin's 'last of the gems' scene and second battle (sets 0x009).

0x008@npc/28.name: denvrado_told_see_aruvin
0x008@npc/28.summary: Villager told you to see Aruvin about your sickness
0x008@npc/28.detail: Set the first time the Villager (npc/28) remarks that you look sick and points you to Saint Aruvin; afterwards he repeats the advice.

0x008@npc/3.name: isten_carmens_father_talked
0x008@npc/3.summary: Talked to Carmen's father about Marco
0x008@npc/3.detail: Set the first time you talk to the Old Man (Carmen's father, npc/3) before the mayor's fight; he says Marco would be the perfect mayor. One of the four talks (0x008, 0x009, 0x00E, 0x00F) the Isten innkeeper wants done before the fight.

0x008@npc/30.name: gods_tower_mother_moves
0x008@npc/30.summary: Summit aftermath: the mother moved to the Baby
0x008@npc/30.detail: Set with 0x007 at the start of the post-0x0E6 summit scene (npc/30). Never tested.

0x008@npc/34.name: jungo_innkeeper_spoke
0x008@npc/34.summary: Innkeeper has made his remark on the port
0x008@npc/34.detail: Set by the Jungo Innkeeper's remark about the couple (npc/34); his actor on the port disappears once it is set.

0x008@npc/39.name: zed_attack_bosmie_confronted
0x008@npc/39.summary: Confronted Bosmie; the gargoyles spread out
0x008@npc/39.detail: Set the first time Bosmie (npc/39) shouts to kill all humans. The four gargoyles move to the townspeople and can be fought, and the townsfolk beg for help.

0x008@npc/4.name: san_claria_jiggy_fur_fish_line
0x008@npc/4.summary: Jiggy switches to his fur fish slogan line
0x008@npc/4.detail: Only tested by Jiggy (npc/4), who then quotes 'Let's go to San Claria' slogan. Nothing in npc/4 sets it; the husband in npc/5 sets 0x008 after telling you the village's new slogan, which fits.

0x008@npc/41.name: rogo_artifact_delivered
0x008@npc/41.summary: Galik has the artifact: Rogo says good job
0x008@npc/41.detail: Set by Galik in Carmarthen (npc/13). At Rogo's (npc/41) he says 'Good job' (sets 0x011), the dig trigger stops and the actors move.

0x008@npc/42.name: zephyr_passenger_scene_temp
0x008@npc/42.summary: Temporary flag in the sick Passenger's scene
0x008@npc/42.detail: Set and cleared again inside the Passenger's scene (npc/42). Never tested.

0x008@npc/44.name: north_tower_ring_found
0x008@npc/44.detail: Set in Jadik's scene in the North Tower (npc/44) just before 0x091 and a scratch wipe, so it is cleared at once. Never tested.

0x008@npc/45.name: kuldo_artifact_delivered
0x008@npc/45.summary: Galik identified the key (removes a Kuldo actor)
0x008@npc/45.detail: Set by Galik in Carmarthen (npc/13). In the Kuldo Ruins (npc/45) only a placement tests it: the travelling Merchant by the entrance (actor 24) is gone once it is set.

0x008@npc/48.name: zed_mansion_kalkanor_waiting
0x008@npc/48.summary: Back from Galik: Kalkanor is at the Governor's
0x008@npc/48.detail: Set by Galik in Carmarthen (npc/13). In the mansion (npc/48) it places Kalkanor, Ramal and Gwinladin and the trigger plays the scene where you trade the heavy stone for tickets.

0x008@npc/5.name: san_claria_slogan_heard
0x008@npc/5.summary: Heard the village's new fur fish slogan
0x008@npc/5.detail: Set the first time you talk to the Husband in the San Claria house (npc/5), who tells you the new slogan; afterwards he complains he has no fur to make tunics. Jiggy outside (npc/4) quotes the slogan when it is set.

0x008@npc/9.name: picard_entered_side_room
0x008@npc/9.summary: Stepped into the side room (reunion pending)
0x008@npc/9.detail: Set by the invisible warp into the side room (npc/9 actor 11, with 0x0FB); places that actor on arrival until the companions are found (0x005).

0x009@npc/10.name: zed_tickets_obtained
0x009@npc/10.summary: Got the ship tickets from the Governor
0x009@npc/10.detail: Set in the Governor's mansion (npc/48) when he trades tickets for the heavy stone. With 0x008, the Sailor on the docks (npc/10) takes the tickets and lets you board (sets 0x016).

0x009@npc/15.name: den_heldar_gamella_thanked
0x009@npc/15.summary: Gamella has greeted you this visit
0x009@npc/15.detail: Set the first time you talk to Gamella, the Mayor's daughter (npc/15), after each stage (father rescued 0x090, Trisken man saved 0x091, 0x092, or the 0x0E6 crisis); afterwards she just invites you back.

0x009@npc/18.name: kerple_island_remark_pending
0x009@npc/18.summary: Just woke on the beach; island remark pending
0x009@npc/18.detail: Set by the beach wake-up scene (npc/18). Next time the beach trigger runs, the companion remarks 'This must be an island...' and clears it.

0x009@npc/2.name: isten_wedding_walk_3
0x009@npc/2.detail: Set at the end of the wedding procession (npc/2), just before 0x032 starts the wedding party. Never tested.

0x009@npc/21.name: trisken_attack_spare_gargoyle_a
0x009@npc/21.detail: Set by gargoyle actor 28 in npc/21, which is absent in every case, so it never happens in play.

0x009@npc/24.name: castle_party_kalkanor_talked
0x009@npc/24.detail: Set the first time you talk to Kalkanor at the castle party (npc/24); he gives item 1039 if 0x0AC is set. One of the five guest talks that lead to the purse theft (0x008).

0x009@npc/27.name: garam_cave_gwinladin_fought
0x009@npc/27.summary: Broke free of the spell and fought Gwinladin
0x009@npc/27.detail: Set in Gwinladin's scene in the cave (npc/27) before the fight. Repositions the party and the trigger then plays Kalkanor's parting scene, which sets 0x08A and wipes scratch.

0x009@npc/3.name: isten_carmen_talked
0x009@npc/3.summary: Talked to Carmen: she won't marry Richten
0x009@npc/3.detail: Set the first time you talk to Carmen (npc/3) before the fight. Without it the innkeeper asks if you spoke to the mayor's daughter; with all four talks he offers the free room that leads to the fight (0x012).

0x009@npc/34.name: jungo_sailor_moved
0x009@npc/34.summary: Sailor stands in his alternate spot
0x009@npc/34.detail: Only a placement on the Jungo port (npc/34) tests it, moving the Sailor slightly. Nothing in Jungo sets it.

0x009@npc/39.name: zed_attack_gargoyles_cleared
0x009@npc/39.summary: All four gargoyles beaten; Bosmie is next
0x009@npc/39.detail: Set when the last of 0x002-0x005 is beaten ('Then we get their leader!', npc/39). Bosmie then starts the ringleader fight, sets 0x09E and wipes scratch.

0x009@npc/4.name: san_claria_jiggy_welcomed
0x009@npc/4.summary: Jiggy welcomed you to San Claria
0x009@npc/4.detail: Set the first time you talk to Jiggy (npc/4); afterwards he uses a shorter welcome. Jiggy also tests 0x008 for a third line, but nothing in npc/4 sets 0x008.

0x009@npc/44.name: north_tower_jadik_thanks
0x009@npc/44.detail: Set in Jadik's scene in the North Tower (npc/44) just before 0x091 and a scratch wipe, so it is cleared at once. Never tested.

0x009@npc/48.name: zed_stone_traded_for_tickets
0x009@npc/48.summary: Traded the heavy stone to the Governor for tickets
0x009@npc/48.detail: Set in Kalkanor's scene at the Governor's mansion (npc/48) as the Governor begs for the emerald; you then hand over the stone and get the tickets (clears 0x004 and 0x012). Afterwards the trigger stops and the Governor tells you to get out.

0x009@npc/9.name: picard_all_books_read
0x009@npc/9.summary: Read all four books in Picard's library
0x009@npc/9.detail: Set once 0x001-0x004 are all set (npc/9): the companion says they have seen all there is to see. With the gate key (0x085) Darkbeat then sets 0x0A5 to send you after the Holy Armor; before that the barrier line mentions Darkbeat's exit.

0x00A@npc/10.name: zed_bonik_scene_seen
0x00A@npc/10.detail: Set by Bonik's scene in the Zed Harbor ticket office (npc/11). The fur fish Merchant on the streets (npc/10) then uses a different greeting.

0x00A@npc/11.name: zed_bonik_ticket_scene_done
0x00A@npc/11.detail: Set at the start of the scene where Bonik thanks you for Isten and his customer buys the last tickets (npc/11). It stops the trigger and removes Bonik.

0x00A@npc/18.name: kerple_shrine_entry_ok
0x00A@npc/18.summary: Companion agreed to enter Yugonga's shrine
0x00A@npc/18.detail: Set at the shrine front (npc/18) when 0x003-0x006 are all set: the companion says Yugonga is somewhere in the shrine and walks on. Stops the 'talk to more tribespeople' trigger.

0x00A@npc/2.name: isten_artema_follower_met
0x00A@npc/2.summary: Heard the Artema follower's sermon at the temple
0x00A@npc/2.detail: Set the first time you talk to the Follower outside the temple of Artema (npc/2); afterwards he just welcomes you to the temple. The wedding party scene also sets it as a step marker.

0x00A@npc/21.name: trisken_attack_spare_gargoyle_b
0x00A@npc/21.detail: Set by gargoyle actor 29 in npc/21, which is absent in every case, so it never happens in play.

0x00A@npc/24.name: castle_party_gwinladin_talked
0x00A@npc/24.summary: Party: Gwinladin sneered about Jadik's rescue
0x00A@npc/24.detail: Set the first time you talk to Gwinladin at the castle party (npc/24). One of the five guest talks.

0x00A@npc/27.name: garam_cave_kalkanor_leaving
0x00A@npc/27.summary: Kalkanor announced they are off to God's Tower
0x00A@npc/27.detail: Set in Kalkanor's parting scene (npc/27) just before 0x08A and the scratch wipe, so it is cleared at once. Never tested.

0x00A@npc/29.name: denvrado_mayor_welcome
0x00A@npc/29.detail: Set the first time you talk to the Mayor in his house (npc/29), who says outsiders rarely come up here; afterwards he asks whether you are friends of the three Triskenians who passed by.

0x00A@npc/30.name: gods_tower_baby_alive
0x00A@npc/30.summary: Summit aftermath: the Baby is alive
0x00A@npc/30.detail: Set in the post-0x0E6 summit scene (npc/30) when the Baby wakes and calls for its mother. Darkbeat then shouts to run and Ibkee barks in alarm.

0x00A@npc/34.name: jungo_couple_seen
0x00A@npc/34.summary: Saw the happy couple; the Sailor's dock talk is armed
0x00A@npc/34.detail: Set when the companion remarks 'What a nice, happy couple' (npc/34). From then on the port zones run the Sailor's script, which offers boarding once 0x00C is set.

0x00A@npc/4.name: san_claria_poem_overheard
0x00A@npc/4.summary: Caught the Poet reciting his poem
0x00A@npc/4.detail: Set the first time you talk to the Poet by the river (npc/4); afterwards he frets that everyone will hear about his poem.

0x00A@npc/44.name: north_tower_jadik_introduced
0x00A@npc/44.detail: Set in Jadik's scene in the North Tower (npc/44) just before 0x091 and a scratch wipe, so it is cleared at once. Never tested.

0x00A@npc/9.name: picard_library_seen_with_key
0x00A@npc/9.summary: Saw the library after getting the gate key
0x00A@npc/9.detail: Set when the companion marvels at the books (npc/9) once 0x085 is set; the library trigger then runs Darkbeat's check, which sets 0x0A5 if all books are read.

0x00B@npc/18.name: kerple_baby_released
0x00B@npc/18.detail: Set in the Chief's thank-you scene at the shrine (npc/18) as he releases the 'pig'. Never tested.

0x00B@npc/2.name: isten_lady_richten_gossip
0x00B@npc/2.summary: Heard the Lady say Richten is faking his injury
0x00B@npc/2.detail: Set the first time you talk to the Lady in Isten's square (npc/2); afterwards she only says she loves detective work. The wedding party scene also sets it as a step marker.

0x00B@npc/24.name: castle_party_ramal_talked
0x00B@npc/24.detail: Set the first time you talk to Ramal at the castle party (npc/24). One of the five guest talks.

0x00B@npc/27.name: garam_cave_entered_left
0x00B@npc/27.summary: Cave approach from one side (arrival path A)
0x00B@npc/27.detail: Set by two of the cave's trigger zones once 0x003 is set (npc/27); starts Kalkanor's arrival and picks the walk paths for the Knight and Baby. 0x00C is the other side.

0x00B@npc/30.name: gods_tower_mother_farewell
0x00B@npc/30.detail: Set in the post-0x0E6 summit scene (npc/30) as the Baby cries for its mother. Only a placement tests it, and it gives the same position either way.

0x00B@npc/34.name: jungo_baby_named
0x00B@npc/34.summary: Named the Jungo couple's unborn son
0x00B@npc/34.detail: Set in Jungo's interiors (npc/35) when you name the expectant couple's son. One of the boarding conditions checked by Bonik's port scene (npc/34).

0x00B@npc/35.name: jungo_son_named
0x00B@npc/35.detail: Set when the Man (npc/35) asks you to name his son (stored as $E) and gives item 1043; afterwards he looks forward to the birth. One of the boarding conditions.

0x00B@npc/42.name: zephyr_boarded_for_jungo
0x00B@npc/42.detail: Set when the companion says they finally made it on board (npc/42, first voyage). Arms the next cabin scene ('the ship's moving!'), changes the Captain's greeting and the cabin door.

0x00B@npc/44.name: north_tower_darkbeat_startled
0x00B@npc/44.summary: Met Darkbeat and Ibkee: they were startled
0x00B@npc/44.detail: Set while you run into Darkbeat and Ibkee in the North Tower (npc/44), just before 0x063 and a scratch wipe, so it is cleared at once. Never tested.

0x00B@npc/5.name: san_claria_old_lady_talked
0x00B@npc/5.summary: Heard the Old Lady miss the fur fish
0x00B@npc/5.detail: Set the first time you talk to the Old Lady in San Claria (npc/5); afterwards her mouth just waters at the thought of fur fish.

0x00B@npc/9.name: picard_woke_up
0x00B@npc/9.summary: Woke up in Picard; Ibkee said the others are nearby
0x00B@npc/9.detail: Set by Ibkee's greeting when you first come to in Picard (npc/9, 'This is Picard. We're safe here'). Moves Ibkee and arms the triggers that lead to the side-room reunion.

0x00C@npc/14.name: den_heldar_treasure_gossip_heard
0x00C@npc/14.detail: Set the first time you talk to a Citizen (npc/14, actor 10) about the North Tower treasure, before or after 0x090; afterwards he uses his follow-up line.

0x00C@npc/18.name: kerple_reward_pending
0x00C@npc/18.summary: Chief wants to reward you in the village
0x00C@npc/18.detail: Set by the Chief's release scene at the shrine (npc/18). Back in the square the trigger plays the reward talk (you ask for a boat and he offers 'Chester'), which clears it and sets 0x00D.

0x00C@npc/2.name: isten_wedding_party_drinks
0x00C@npc/2.detail: Set in the wedding party scene (npc/2) after the late guest orders drinks. Never tested; a step marker in the scene that ends with the Knight carried to the inn.

0x00C@npc/24.name: castle_party_noblewoman_talked
0x00C@npc/24.detail: Set the first time you talk to the Noblewoman at the castle party (npc/24). One of the five guest talks; her purse is the one stolen.

0x00C@npc/27.name: garam_cave_entered_right
0x00C@npc/27.summary: Cave approach from the other side (arrival path B)
0x00C@npc/27.detail: Set by the other two cave trigger zones once 0x003 is set (npc/27); starts Kalkanor's arrival with the alternative walk paths.

0x00C@npc/3.name: isten_inn_talks_missing
0x00C@npc/3.summary: Innkeeper check: some pre-fight talks still missing
0x00C@npc/3.detail: Temporary flag in the Isten innkeeper's script (npc/3): set at the start, cleared when Marco, Darkbeat and Carmen's father have all been talked to. If still set he gives the 'you're the one Richten hired' line instead of the fight-eve offer.

0x00C@npc/34.name: jungo_ready_to_board
0x00C@npc/34.summary: Done in Jungo: the ship can board
0x00C@npc/34.detail: Set by whichever of the four Jungo tasks finishes last (Darkbeat 0x001, Bonik 0x003, naming 0x00B, chest item 1042). The Sailor then asks if you are ready to board, and Aki, the Woman and Pengie say goodbye.

0x00C@npc/35.name: jungo_tasks_done
0x00C@npc/35.detail: Set in npc/35 by Darkbeat, the naming Man or the chest with item 1042 when the other conditions (0x001, 0x003, 0x00B, item 1042) are already met. The Jungo Sailor (npc/34) then lets you board.

0x00C@npc/40.name: kell_promised_to_kill_mushmare
0x00C@npc/40.summary: Promised the Kell innkeeper to kill the Mushmare
0x00C@npc/40.detail: Set when you accept the Kell innkeeper's free room on the promise of killing the Mushmare (npc/40); refusing clears it. Never tested.

0x00C@npc/42.name: zephyr_bonik_greeted
0x00C@npc/42.detail: Set the first time you talk to Bonik on the Zephyr (npc/42); afterwards he just wishes you luck.

0x00C@npc/44.name: north_tower_darkbeat_spotted
0x00C@npc/44.summary: Met Darkbeat and Ibkee in the tower
0x00C@npc/44.detail: Set while you run into Darkbeat and Ibkee in the North Tower (npc/44), just before 0x063 and a scratch wipe, so it is cleared at once. Never tested.

0x00D@npc/14.name: den_heldar_old_man_talked
0x00D@npc/14.summary: Heard the Old Man's first remark
0x00D@npc/14.detail: Set the first time you talk to the Old Man in Den Heldar (npc/14), before 0x090 (asks about your boat) or after 0x092; afterwards he talks about your water bug or just snores.

0x00D@npc/18.name: kerple_asked_for_boat
0x00D@npc/18.summary: Asked the Chief for a boat
0x00D@npc/18.detail: Set at the start of the square reward talk (npc/18). In the Chief's hut (npc/19) it triggers the scene where he hands over the Chester flute (item 184), then cleared.

0x00D@npc/19.name: kerple_flute_scene_pending
0x00D@npc/19.summary: Chief is about to hand over the flute
0x00D@npc/19.detail: Set by the reward talk in the square (npc/18). In the Chief's hut (npc/19) it triggers his flute scene, which clears it.

0x00D@npc/2.name: isten_bet_placed
0x00D@npc/2.summary: Placed a bet with the Bookie on the mayor's fight
0x00D@npc/2.detail: Set when you pay the Bookie (npc/2) 20 or 40 rubies on the Pig or the Walrus; afterwards he says only one bet per customer. The later wedding party scene also sets it as a step marker.

0x00D@npc/21.name: trisken_attack_alarm_raised
0x00D@npc/21.summary: Companion raised the alarm about the Cult attack
0x00D@npc/21.detail: Set on arrival in Trisken during the Artema Cult attack (npc/21, 'We have to help! Hurry!'). Afterwards the companion stops you leaving with 'Where are you going?'.

0x00D@npc/24.name: castle_party_thief_talked
0x00D@npc/24.summary: Party: chatted with the guest who is the thief
0x00D@npc/24.detail: Set the first time you talk to the guest (npc/24, actor 8) who praises Kalkanor; he later turns out to be the purse thief. One of the five guest talks.

0x00D@npc/34.name: jungo_boarded_zephyr
0x00D@npc/34.summary: Boarded the ship from Jungo to Trisken
0x00D@npc/34.detail: Set after a scratch wipe when you tell the Jungo Sailor you are ready (npc/34; objective 'Trisken, here we come!'). Stops the port triggers and switches the port doors.

0x00D@npc/40.name: kell_mushmare_fought
0x00D@npc/40.detail: Set as the Mushmare battle starts (npc/40). Moves the Kellians, and the village trigger then plays the Elder's thanks (sets 0x082, 0x015); the other Elder gives you O'Neal and clears it.

0x00D@npc/42.name: zephyr_captain_greeted
0x00D@npc/42.summary: Met the Captain on the first voyage
0x00D@npc/42.detail: Set the first time the Captain hails you as a landlubber (npc/42); afterwards he gives his cast-off or 'Jungo!' line.

0x00D@npc/44.name: north_tower_darkbeat_plan
0x00D@npc/44.summary: Met Darkbeat and Ibkee: learned the captives are inside
0x00D@npc/44.detail: Set while you run into Darkbeat and Ibkee in the North Tower (npc/44), just before 0x063 and a scratch wipe, so it is cleared at once. Never tested.

0x00D@npc/6.name: orgo_baby_followed_home
0x00D@npc/6.summary: The baby monster followed you to the Mayor's
0x00D@npc/6.detail: Set by the Orgo night scene (npc/6) when the companion sees the baby following and says to ask the Mayor, just before the warp into the Mayor's house. npc/7 then places the baby there.

0x00D@npc/7.name: orgo_baby_in_mayors_house
0x00D@npc/7.summary: The baby monster is in the Mayor's house
0x00D@npc/7.detail: Set by the Orgo night scene (npc/6) before warping inside; places the baby (actor 22) in the Mayor's house (npc/7) until 0x081.

0x00E@npc/21.name: trisken_attack_fight_started
0x00E@npc/21.summary: A Cult fight in Trisken has started
0x00E@npc/21.detail: Set at the start of every gargoyle and Org encounter in npc/21. Never tested.

0x00E@npc/22.name: trisken_king_scene_baby_found
0x00E@npc/22.summary: Throne room: found the runaway Baby with the King
0x00E@npc/22.detail: Set in the throne-room scene (npc/22, with 0x095) when you catch up with the Baby; it places the King and the Royal Advisor in the throne room until 0x08C.

0x00E@npc/3.name: isten_marco_talked
0x00E@npc/3.summary: Met Marco, the candidate you will fight against
0x00E@npc/3.detail: Set the first time you talk to Marco (npc/3) as Richten's stand-in; needed for the innkeeper's fight-eve offer. The later Marco rescue scene also sets it as its last step.

0x00E@npc/30.name: gods_tower_seal_seen
0x00E@npc/30.summary: Summit: saw the sealed Xizan's resting place
0x00E@npc/30.detail: Set at the very start of the summit scene (npc/30) after 'Oh, no!! Look!'. Never tested.

0x00E@npc/42.name: zephyr_arriving_jungo
0x00E@npc/42.summary: Voyage to Jungo: ship tour done / docked
0x00E@npc/42.detail: Set when the companion says you have walked around the whole ship, and again after the docking announcement (npc/42); a deck zone also sets it after a scratch wipe. While set, Darkbeat and Ibkee are no longer on deck, the Captain shouts 'Jungo!' and the doors lead ashore.

0x00E@npc/44.name: north_tower_guard_battle_begun
0x00E@npc/44.summary: Battle with the captives' guards has begun
0x00E@npc/44.detail: Set together with 0x001 before the guard monster battle in the North Tower (npc/44). Never tested.

0x00E@npc/7.name: orgo_day_one_woken
0x00E@npc/7.summary: Woken up on the first morning
0x00E@npc/7.detail: Set by the opening wake-up scene in the Knight's house (npc/7, 'Wake up you sleepy head'). It stops that trigger from replaying and removes the waker.

0x00F@npc/22.name: trisken_king_scene_greeted
0x00F@npc/22.summary: Throne room: the King spoke to you
0x00F@npc/22.detail: Set (twice) in the throne-room scene (npc/22) as the King steps in about his guards. Never tested; scene step marker followed by 0x010 and 0x011.

0x00F@npc/3.name: isten_darkbeat_talked
0x00F@npc/3.detail: Set the first time you talk to Darkbeat (npc/3), who promises to go easy on you. Needed for the Isten innkeeper's fight-eve offer.

0x00F@npc/30.name: gods_tower_karmine_defeated
0x00F@npc/30.summary: Summit: Karmine defeated, the Baby badly hurt
0x00F@npc/30.detail: Set with 0x0E6 when Karmine, beaten, calls on Xizan to take him (npc/30). Never tested.

0x00F@npc/34.name: jungo_woman_talked
0x00F@npc/34.summary: Heard the Woman praise the orphan children
0x00F@npc/34.detail: Set the first time you talk to the Woman on the Jungo port (npc/34); afterwards she wishes you a safe cruise.

0x00F@npc/40.name: kell_guard_led_to_elder
0x00F@npc/40.summary: A Kell guard is taking you to the Elder
0x00F@npc/40.detail: Set at the end of the gate guards' scene (npc/40, 'You can speak with the Elder'). Moves several Kellians, and the village trigger plays the scene where you are presented to the Elder, which clears it and sets 0x010.

0x00F@npc/45.name: kuldo_kalkanor_gloats
0x00F@npc/45.summary: Kuldo Ruins: Kalkanor's party gloated over the emerald
0x00F@npc/45.detail: Set in the scene after the Winged Lion battle (npc/45) as Kalkanor's group congratulate themselves. Never tested; 0x010 follows.

0x010@npc/2.name: isten_richten_enters_ring
0x010@npc/2.summary: Richten steps into the ring (match scene cue)
0x010@npc/2.detail: Set in Richten's match scene right after he says 'Wait here.' Richten's arena actor (13) waits on it in his walk script and walks into the ring; nothing else tests it.

0x010@npc/22.name: trisken_king_gate_speech_cue
0x010@npc/22.summary: King finished his speech about the gate (scene cue)
0x010@npc/22.detail: Set in the King's scene at the Eastern Pass gate (chunk 274) after he explains what the gates keep out. The King's walk script waits on it to turn; nothing else reads it.

0x010@npc/30.name: gods_tower_must_flee
0x010@npc/30.summary: Party decided to flee the collapsing tower
0x010@npc/30.detail: Set in Celestia's aftermath scene on the summit when the hero tells the Baby it's too dangerous to stay. Darkbeat (actor 15) is gone, Celestia's walk script moves on, and the summit trigger then plays the mysterious voice's farewell to Celestia, which warps you out to chunk 415.

0x010@npc/40.name: kell_mushmare_quest_accepted
0x010@npc/40.summary: Agreed to kill the Mushmare for the Kellian Elder
0x010@npc/40.detail: Set by the Kellian (actor 4) scene when you agree to help; it clears 0x00F. While set, the Elder's chunk starts the Mushmare encounter, chunk 412 offers the storage room, one gate guard leaves and the others say 'We are a peaceful tribe...'. Cleared when the Mushmare appears (that scene sets 0x00D).

0x010@npc/45.name: kuldo_kalkanor_took_emerald
0x010@npc/45.summary: Kalkanor's party took the emerald and left
0x010@npc/45.detail: Set at the end of the boss-room scene after Kalkanor says 'You are too late, boy.' Gwinladin and the party walk off and stay gone, and the chunk-431 trigger then plays the hero's 'They took the emerald' line, which sets 0x007 and points you back to Zed Harbor.

0x011@npc/2.name: isten_bonik_taken_hostage
0x011@npc/2.summary: Bonik led away as Richten's hostage
0x011@npc/2.detail: Set in the gate scene (chunk 46) as Bonik walks off with Richten's men, just before Richten introduces himself. The four men at the gate vanish and a second bodyguard now blocks the far side of town (chunk 48).

0x011@npc/22.name: trisken_king_calls_guards_cue
0x011@npc/22.summary: King called the gate guards over (scene cue)
0x011@npc/22.detail: Set in the King's Eastern Pass scene after 'You there, guards!'. A gate guard's walk script (actor 48) waits on it to step forward; nothing else reads it.

0x011@npc/30.name: gods_tower_voice_appears
0x011@npc/30.summary: Mysterious voice came to take Celestia home
0x011@npc/30.detail: Set at the start of the farewell scene that the summit trigger plays once 0x010 is set. It places actor 19, whom the camera follows while the unseen '???' thanks Celestia, before you are warped out of the tower.

0x011@npc/40.name: kell_elder_denies_pink_monster
0x011@npc/40.summary: Elder says he hasn't seen any pink monsters
0x011@npc/40.detail: Set by a chunk-386 trigger record once 0x082 is set, but no pack in the table serves chunk 386, so it may only fire if npc/40 stays loaded there. While set, the later Elder (actor 25) says he hasn't seen any pink monsters instead of pointing to the inner caves.

0x011@npc/41.name: rogo_thanked_for_delivery
0x011@npc/41.summary: Rogo thanked you for delivering his package
0x011@npc/41.detail: Set by Rogo (either of his actors) when you come back after the delivery to Galik (0x008); it also clears 0x013. From then on he only says 'Good job.'

0x012@npc/10.name: zed_kalkanor_left_for_emerald
0x012@npc/10.summary: Kalkanor's party left the dock for the emerald
0x012@npc/10.detail: Set at the Zed Harbor dock when Kalkanor's party walks off after 'Our only concern is with the Kuldo Emerald!' Nothing reads it; the Governor (npc/48) clears it when he trades you the tickets.

0x012@npc/2.name: isten_match_day
0x012@npc/2.summary: Rested at the inn; the mayoral match is today
0x012@npc/2.detail: Set by the Isten innkeeper (npc/3) when you accept the free night before the fight. In town the crowd, Marco and Richten gather at the arena, and entering chunk 48 starts Richten's match scene.

0x012@npc/22.name: trisken_guards_open_gate_cue
0x012@npc/22.summary: Gate guards step aside on the King's order (cue)
0x012@npc/22.detail: Set at the end of the King's Eastern Pass scene after 'Live long young ones'. Both gate guards' walk scripts wait on it to step aside; the scene then sets 0x08C and warps you.

0x012@npc/3.name: isten_rested_before_match
0x012@npc/3.summary: Accepted the free night before the mayoral match
0x012@npc/3.detail: Set by the inn Keeper (actor 2) once the pre-fight talks are done (0x00E, 0x00F, 0x008, 0x009) and you agree to rest. Next morning the inn trigger plays the Keeper's wake-up scene, where Richten is waiting to escort you to the arena (npc/2).

0x012@npc/30.name: gods_tower_mutate_order_cue
0x012@npc/30.summary: Karmine ordered his followers to mutate (cue)
0x012@npc/30.detail: Set in the first summit scene right after Karmine's order to mutate. Karmine's walk script, and those of Darkbeat and Ibkee, wait on it before their next move.

0x012@npc/40.name: kell_guard_steps_up_cue
0x012@npc/40.summary: Kell gate guard stepped forward (scene cue)
0x012@npc/40.detail: Set when you talk to the guards at Kell's entrance (actor 16's scene) as the lead guard walks up. The other two guards' walk scripts wait on it to turn toward you.

0x012@npc/48.name: zed_kalkanor_emerald_hunt
0x012@npc/48.summary: Kalkanor's party left the dock for the emerald
0x012@npc/48.detail: Only cleared here: the Governor clears it (with 0x004) when he takes the Heavy Stone and hands you the tickets. It is set at the docks (npc/10) and nothing reads it.

0x013@npc/2.name: isten_match_fought
0x013@npc/2.detail: Set in Richten's match scene just before the fight (battle 0x108); Marco's and Richten's walk scripts also use it as a cue. Afterwards the bodyguards, bookie and Richten are gone, villagers remark how quiet it is, and zone triggers near the exits set 0x014 or 0x015.

0x013@npc/22.name: trisken_baby_runs_to_gate
0x013@npc/22.summary: Baby ran ahead toward the Eastern Pass gate
0x013@npc/22.detail: Set in the first Eastern Pass scene (actor 1, chunk 274) as the Baby runs ahead and the hero asks what's wrong. Nothing reads it; the scene goes on to set 0x05A.

0x013@npc/3.name: isten_after_the_match
0x013@npc/3.summary: Mayoral match is over; you wake at the inn
0x013@npc/3.detail: Set in npc/2's match scene. At the inn the trigger plays the wake-up scenes (actor 19), the Keeper rents rooms normally, Darkbeat is gone, and Richten's house is empty ('Richten ran away') with a chest to find.

0x013@npc/30.name: gods_tower_karmine_turns_cue
0x013@npc/30.summary: Karmine turned from Darkbeat to the hero (cue)
0x013@npc/30.detail: Set in the second summit scene after Karmine mocks the wounded Darkbeat. Karmine's walk script waits on it to turn before he notices the hero and the fight (battle 0x118) starts.

0x013@npc/40.name: kell_guards_confer_cue
0x013@npc/40.summary: Kell guards heard you ask about the pink monster
0x013@npc/40.detail: Set in the gate-guard scene right after you ask about a pink monster. All three guards' walk scripts wait on it before they whisper among themselves.

0x013@npc/41.name: rogo_errand_underway
0x013@npc/41.summary: Walked off with Rogo's package for Galik
0x013@npc/41.detail: Set by a chunk-443 trigger record once Rogo has handed you the package (0x006). While set Rogo stands at a different spot (he re-places as soon as it is set); he clears it when he thanks you (0x011).

0x014@npc/2.name: isten_marco_at_back_exit
0x014@npc/2.summary: Reached the exit away from Zed Harbor after the match
0x014@npc/2.detail: Set by a chunk-48 zone trigger once 0x013 is set. It places Marco by that exit and starts his farewell: he pays you 500 rubies and says to leave by the opposite gate for Zed Harbor, then sets 0x087 and wipes the scratch flags.

0x014@npc/22.name: trisken_tourists_turned_nasty
0x014@npc/22.summary: Tourist couple told you to get lost for good
0x014@npc/22.detail: Set by the tourist husband (chunk 271) on your third talk, when he takes 1500 rubies back, and again on any later talk ('Beat it, you little punks!'). Nothing reads it.

0x014@npc/30.name: gods_tower_baby_revived_cue
0x014@npc/30.summary: Celestia's light revived the Baby (scene cue)
0x014@npc/30.detail: Set in Celestia's aftermath scene after the burst of light, as the hero asks 'What was that?'. Celestia's walk script waits on it to change pose before the Baby wakes.

0x014@npc/40.name: kell_guard_leads_to_elder_cue
0x014@npc/40.summary: Kell guard agreed to take you to the Elder (cue)
0x014@npc/40.detail: Set in the gate-guard scene when the lead guard says he'll take you to the Elder and the others should keep watch. The guards' walk scripts wait on it; 0x00F follows a line later.

0x015@npc/11.name: zed_bonik_walks_to_counter_cue
0x015@npc/11.summary: Bonik walks to the ticket counter (scene cue)
0x015@npc/11.detail: Set in Bonik's ticket-office scene after he tells you he'll open a store in Jungo. His walk script waits on it to walk off; he then buys the last ticket (0x002).

0x015@npc/2.name: isten_marco_at_east_exit
0x015@npc/2.summary: Reached the Zed Harbor exit after the match
0x015@npc/2.detail: Set by a chunk-48 zone trigger once 0x013 is set. It places Marco by that exit and starts his farewell: 500 rubies and directions east to Zed Harbor, after which he sets 0x087 and wipes the scratch flags.

0x015@npc/30.name: gods_tower_ibkee_worried
0x015@npc/30.summary: Ibkee checked on the wounded Darkbeat
0x015@npc/30.detail: Set in Celestia's aftermath scene when Ibkee asks 'Ark ark?', just before Darkbeat says his wound isn't fatal. Nothing reads it.

0x015@npc/40.name: kell_elder_showed_the_way
0x015@npc/40.summary: Elder told you where the pink monster went
0x015@npc/40.detail: Set by the Elder once the Mushmare is dead (with 0x082). While set a Kellian (actor 21) and actor 20 stand at new spots; it is cleared at the nest when you find the Baby asleep.

0x016@npc/1.name: bonik_shop_picked_hamburger
0x016@npc/1.summary: Picked the Hamburger in Bonik's night shop
0x016@npc/1.detail: Bonik's night shop (shop 2) lists Hamburger, Cheeseburger, Bubble Gum, Terror Seed and AFM324, and slot N matches flag 0x016+N; no script sets it, so the shop code must (the decomp shows it reading 0x16–0x1A). When set, Bonik gives the Hamburger free and records it in 0x01E; if you leave without picking it he hands it over anyway.
0x016@npc/1.engine: Scratch flag owned by shop 2 (Bonik's stall, npc/1): picking 'Hamburger' (row 0) sets it and closes the shop without charging or giving anything, so Bonik's script can react; once set, the row is greyed and can't be picked again. When 0x016–0x01A are all set the shop also sets 0x01B.

0x016@npc/10.name: zed_tickets_handed_to_sailor
0x016@npc/10.summary: Handed the ship tickets to the dock sailor
0x016@npc/10.detail: Set by the dock Sailor once 0x008 and 0x009 are set (after the Governor's ticket trade), as he takes the tickets (item 512). While set the dock's auto-scenes stop and he just urges you aboard.

0x016@npc/30.name: gods_tower_karmine_seizes_baby
0x016@npc/30.summary: Karmine lunged for the Baby to take the seal
0x016@npc/30.detail: Set in the first summit scene on the hero's '$B, look out!', before Karmine draws the sealed Xizan out of the Baby. Karmine's walk script waits on it, and an unnamed actor (28) appears at the centre.

0x016@npc/40.name: kell_fought_nest_bird
0x016@npc/40.summary: Fought the giant bird at its nest
0x016@npc/40.detail: Set when the bird attacks at the nest, before battle 0x101 (with 0x083). Afterwards the nest trigger plays the aftermath, where the Baby hands over a Heavy Stone, and chunk 341 plays the escape that drops you at the Cave of Fear entrance (chunk 42).

0x017@npc/1.name: bonik_shop_picked_cheeseburger
0x017@npc/1.summary: Picked the Cheeseburger in Bonik's night shop
0x017@npc/1.detail: Second slot of Bonik's shop 2, set by the shop code (no script sets it). When set Bonik gives the Cheeseburger free and records it in 0x01F; otherwise he hands it over when you leave.
0x017@npc/1.engine: Scratch flag owned by shop 2 (Bonik's stall, npc/1): picking 'Cheeseburger' (row 1) sets it and closes the shop without charging or giving anything, so Bonik's script can react; once set, the row is greyed and can't be picked again. When 0x016–0x01A are all set the shop also sets 0x01B.

0x017@npc/40.name: kell_baby_comes_over_cue
0x017@npc/40.summary: Baby comes over after the bird is knocked out (cue)
0x017@npc/40.detail: Set in the nest aftermath when the hero calls 'Come on! ... Hurry up!'. The Baby's walk script (actor 23) waits on it to come over, and it then hands you the Heavy Stone.

0x018@npc/1.name: bonik_shop_picked_bubble_gum
0x018@npc/1.summary: Picked the Bubble Gum in Bonik's night shop
0x018@npc/1.detail: Third slot of Bonik's shop 2, set by the shop code (no script sets it). When set Bonik gives the Bubble Gum free and records it in 0x020; otherwise he hands it over when you leave.
0x018@npc/1.engine: Scratch flag owned by shop 2 (Bonik's stall, npc/1): picking 'Bubble Gum' (row 2) sets it and closes the shop without charging or giving anything, so Bonik's script can react; once set, the row is greyed and can't be picked again. When 0x016–0x01A are all set the shop also sets 0x01B.

0x018@npc/22.name: trisken_old_man_told_origins
0x018@npc/22.summary: Old Man told you how it all started
0x018@npc/22.detail: Set by the Old Man (chunk 272, after 0x08C) when you pick 'How it all started', the story of the Artema cult. With 0x019 also set his menu shrinks to 'About Karmine / Nothing'; both clear when you say No or Nothing.

0x018@npc/31.name: gods_tower_fought_anzo
0x018@npc/31.detail: Set by Anzo (chunk 516) as it reboots under Karmine's login, before battle 0x116. Anzo is then gone, and the chunk trigger re-runs its script to give item 1011 and set 0x0B3.

0x018@npc/40.name: kell_bird_stirs_cue
0x018@npc/40.summary: Bird stirred as you were leaving the nest (cue)
0x018@npc/40.detail: Set in the nest aftermath on the hero's 'No!'. The bird's and the Baby's walk scripts wait on it to move, and the scene then warps you to chunk 341 for the escape.

0x019@npc/1.name: bonik_shop_picked_terror_seed
0x019@npc/1.summary: Picked the Terror Seed in Bonik's night shop
0x019@npc/1.detail: Fourth slot of Bonik's shop 2, set by the shop code (no script sets it). When set Bonik gives the Terror Seed free and records it in 0x021; otherwise he hands it over when you leave.
0x019@npc/1.engine: Scratch flag owned by shop 2 (Bonik's stall, npc/1): picking 'Terror Seed' (row 3) sets it and closes the shop without charging or giving anything, so Bonik's script can react; once set, the row is greyed and can't be picked again. When 0x016–0x01A are all set the shop also sets 0x01B.

0x019@npc/22.name: trisken_old_man_told_goal
0x019@npc/22.summary: Old Man told you about Kalkanor's goal
0x019@npc/22.detail: Set by the Old Man when you pick 'Kalkanor's goal', the tale of Karmine and the Holy Gems. With 0x018 also set his menu shrinks to 'About Karmine / Nothing'; both clear when you say No or Nothing.

0x019@npc/31.name: gods_tower_fought_lanzo
0x019@npc/31.detail: Set by Lanzo (chunk 520) after its 'LOG IN : KARMINE' line, before battle 0x117. Lanzo is then gone, and the chunk trigger re-runs its script to give item 1010 and set 0x0B4.

0x019@npc/40.name: kell_got_heavy_stone_cue
0x019@npc/40.summary: Baby gave you the Heavy Stone (scene cue)
0x019@npc/40.detail: Set in the nest aftermath right after you receive the Heavy Stone (item 507), as the camera swings to the nest and the hero says 'What?'. The Baby's walk script waits on it to turn.

0x019@npc/7.name: orgo_baby_paces_mayors_room_cue
0x019@npc/7.summary: Baby paces the Mayor's room as he lectures (cue)
0x019@npc/7.detail: Set as Mayor Kalan hears about the man in the beam of light; the Baby's walk script (actor 22) waits on it and then paces back and forth. He clears it just before ordering the Baby taken to the Cave of Fear (0x01A).

0x01A@npc/1.name: bonik_shop_asked_for_afm324
0x01A@npc/1.summary: Picked the AFM324 in Bonik's night shop
0x01A@npc/1.detail: Fifth slot of Bonik's shop 2, set by the shop code. Bonik says he must hold it for another customer, sets 0x01D, clears this flag and reopens the shop; with 0x01B set he ends the talk instead.
0x01A@npc/1.engine: Scratch flag owned by shop 2 (Bonik's stall, npc/1): picking 'AFM324' (row 4) sets it and closes the shop without charging or giving anything, so Bonik's script can react; unlike the other four rows it never greys out. When 0x016–0x01A are all set the shop also sets 0x01B.

0x01A@npc/30.name: gods_tower_not_safe_cue
0x01A@npc/30.summary: Hero insisted the tower isn't safe (scene cue)
0x01A@npc/30.detail: Set in Celestia's aftermath scene after the hero tells the Baby the tower isn't safe anymore. Celestia's walk script waits on it before her next move.

0x01A@npc/42.name: zephyr_set_sail_to_jungo
0x01A@npc/42.summary: Zephyr has set sail for Jungo
0x01A@npc/42.detail: Set by the boarding scene (actor 1) when the ship starts moving ('The ship's moving!'), before you rest in the cabin. While set the cabin trigger stops replaying the boarding scenes; the arrival rungs (0x023, 0x024, 0x00E) still run.

0x01A@npc/7.name: orgo_mayor_orders_baby_dumped
0x01A@npc/7.summary: Mayor ordered the Baby left in the Cave of Fear
0x01A@npc/7.detail: Set by Mayor Kalan after he declares the Baby cursed and tells you to take it to the Cave of Fear tomorrow; you then sleep at home. On waking, the bedroom trigger (chunk 326) plays the morning scene, which sets 0x081 and wipes the scratch flags.

0x01B@npc/1.name: bonik_shop_sold_out
0x01B@npc/1.summary: Every item in Bonik's night shop has been picked
