0x01B@npc/1.detail: Written by the engine (the decomp shows a constant write), never by a script. Bonik's script treats it as the end of shopping: picking the AFM324 with it set ends the talk, and saying No with it set skips his free gifts, which fits 'all four items already taken'.
0x01B@npc/1.engine: Scratch flag owned by shop 2 (Bonik, npc/1): set by the shop menu as soon as all five of 0x016–0x01A (Hamburger, Cheeseburger, Bubble Gum, Terror Seed, AFM324) have been picked. The engine never reads it; Bonik's script does.

0x01B@npc/24.name: trisken_baby_sniffed_thief
0x01B@npc/24.summary: Baby sniffed out the purse thief
0x01B@npc/24.detail: Set in the castle thief scene after the hero asks if this is really the thief. Kalkanor's walk script waits on it to step up and ask the man to empty his pockets; it is cleared a moment later when the thief bolts (0x01C).

0x01B@npc/30.name: gods_tower_darkbeat_arrives
0x01B@npc/30.summary: Darkbeat burst in to confront Karmine
0x01B@npc/30.detail: Set in the first summit scene on Darkbeat's 'Karmine! I finally found you!'. Darkbeat's and Ibkee's walk scripts wait on it to walk in, and it keeps actor 28 at the centre.

0x01B@npc/42.name: zephyr_talked_to_captain
0x01B@npc/42.detail: Set by the Captain; one of eight 'talked to everyone' flags (0x01B–0x022) on the first voyage; whoever you talk to last sets 0x023, which lets the hero end the walk-round and nap until Jungo.

0x01C@npc/1.name: bonik_shop_left_empty_handed
0x01C@npc/1.summary: Left Bonik's night shop without picking anything
0x01C@npc/1.detail: Written by the engine (the decomp shows a constant write), never by a script. When the shop closes with it set, Bonik says 'Okay, well then, good night!', hands over whichever of his four items you hadn't picked, then jokes about the AFM324.
0x01C@npc/1.engine: Scratch flag owned by shop 2 (Bonik, npc/1): set when you leave that shop with Exit or the cancel button instead of picking an item. The engine never reads it; Bonik's script uses it for his 'good night' branch.

0x01C@npc/24.name: trisken_thief_bolted
0x01C@npc/24.summary: Purse thief was exposed and ran off
0x01C@npc/24.detail: Set when the thief snaps 'Darn you kids and your pig!' (with 0x01F); his and Kalkanor's walk scripts wait on it. While set, a castle trigger record sets 0x01E when you follow him, which starts the dead-end scene.

0x01C@npc/30.name: gods_tower_ready_to_escape
0x01C@npc/30.summary: Party is ready to get out of the tower
0x01C@npc/30.detail: Set at the end of Celestia's aftermath scene ('let's get out of here, fast!'). Ibkee, Darkbeat and actor 18 disappear from the summit and Celestia's walk script makes its last move.

0x01C@npc/42.name: zephyr_talked_to_bonik
0x01C@npc/42.summary: Talked to Bonik aboard the Zephyr
0x01C@npc/42.detail: Set by Bonik (chunk 418); one of eight 'talked to everyone' flags (0x01B–0x022) on the first voyage; whoever you talk to last sets 0x023, which lets the hero end the walk-round and nap until Jungo.

0x01D@npc/1.name: cave_vow_or_afm_refused
0x01D@npc/1.summary: Vowed to enter the cave / Bonik refused the AFM
0x01D@npc/1.detail: Two uses at different times. At the Cave of Fear entrance (chunk 42) the hero's 'Are you sure you want to go in?' scene sets it, and the chunk trigger then stops replaying scenes there; later, at night in the house, Bonik sets it when he first refuses the AFM324, and his farewell then says it's already promised to another customer.

0x01D@npc/24.name: trisken_castle_exit_sealed
0x01D@npc/24.summary: Kalkanor had the hall sealed to catch the thief
0x01D@npc/24.detail: Set in the stolen-purse scene after Kalkanor orders the guard to seal the exit. The Royal Guard's walk script waits on it to move into the doorway.

0x01D@npc/42.name: zephyr_talked_to_greeting_sailor
0x01D@npc/42.summary: Talked to the sailor who welcomes you aboard
0x01D@npc/42.detail: Set by the sailor who says 'Welcome aboard the Zephyr' (chunk 418); one of eight 'talked to everyone' flags (0x01B–0x022) on the first voyage; whoever you talk to last sets 0x023, which lets the hero end the walk-round and nap until Jungo.

0x01E@npc/1.name: bonik_gave_hamburger
0x01E@npc/1.detail: Set right after Bonik hands over the Hamburger you picked in his shop (0x016), so it isn't given twice. When 0x01E–0x021 are all set his farewell skips the gifts.

0x01E@npc/18.name: kerple_woke_on_beach
0x01E@npc/18.summary: Woke on Kerple's beach after the storm
0x01E@npc/18.detail: Set by the beach wake-up scene (chunk 260), where the hero finds the Baby missing; it also sets 0x009 and 0x001. While set the beach trigger stops replaying it, and npc/19 skips its own wake-up call in chunk 391.

0x01E@npc/19.name: kerple_wakeup_call_done
0x01E@npc/19.detail: Only read here: the chunk-391 trigger stops its '...Wake up' call (which warps you to the beach) once npc/18's beach scene has set this flag.

0x01E@npc/24.name: trisken_thief_cornered
0x01E@npc/24.summary: Chased the thief into a dead end
0x01E@npc/24.detail: Set by a castle trigger record once 0x01C is set, when you follow the fleeing thief. It places him at the dead end and starts his 'It's a dead-end!' scene, which leads to the fight (battle 0x112).

0x01E@npc/40.name: kell_oneal_saw_other_toys
0x01E@npc/40.summary: Mr. O'Neal noticed your other living toys
0x01E@npc/40.detail: Set during Mr. O'Neal's introduction if any of six toy flags is set (0x100, 0x102, 0x103, 0x104, 0x1BB, 0x1C3); each one swaps an item. With it set O'Neal remarks on 'those other toys' and actor 22 plays an animation.

0x01E@npc/42.name: zephyr_talked_to_sailor_captain
0x01E@npc/42.summary: Talked to the sailor who brags about the captain
0x01E@npc/42.detail: Set by the sailor in chunk 418 who says no storm scares the captain; one of eight 'talked to everyone' flags (0x01B–0x022) on the first voyage; whoever you talk to last sets 0x023, which lets the hero end the walk-round and nap until Jungo.

0x01E@npc/6.name: orgo_reacted_to_vision
0x01E@npc/6.summary: Reacted to the vision of the man in the light
0x01E@npc/6.detail: Set by the follow-up scene ('W-W-What was that?') after the vision (0x01F). With it set the chunk-78 trigger plays the next beat: the Baby follows you and you go to ask the Mayor (sets 0x00D, warps to his house).

0x01F@npc/1.name: bonik_gave_cheeseburger
0x01F@npc/1.detail: Set right after Bonik hands over the Cheeseburger you picked in his shop (0x017), so it isn't given twice. When 0x01E–0x021 are all set his farewell skips the gifts.

0x01F@npc/24.name: trisken_thief_fled_hall
0x01F@npc/24.summary: Purse thief has left the hall
0x01F@npc/24.detail: Set with 0x01C when the thief bolts; while it is set, and 0x01E isn't, the thief is gone from the hall.

0x01F@npc/42.name: zephyr_talked_to_traveler_home
0x01F@npc/42.summary: Talked to the traveler heading home
0x01F@npc/42.detail: Set by the traveler in chunk 418 who is going home for the first time in months; one of eight 'talked to everyone' flags (0x01B–0x022) on the first voyage; whoever you talk to last sets 0x023, which lets the hero end the walk-round and nap until Jungo.

0x01F@npc/6.name: orgo_vision_seen
0x01F@npc/6.summary: Stranger told you to take the Baby to God's Tower
0x01F@npc/6.detail: Set by the vision outside Orgo (actor 1, or the stranger, actor 11), where the stranger says to deliver the Baby to its mother in God's Tower. The stranger then disappears and the chunk-78 trigger plays the 'What was that?' reaction (0x01E).

0x020@npc/1.name: bonik_gave_bubble_gum
0x020@npc/1.summary: Bonik handed over his Bubble Gum for free
0x020@npc/1.detail: Set by Bonik at the Coastal Inn at night when flag 0x018 is set (no script sets it, so probably his shop) and he gives you the Bubble Gum (item 15) "for free". His closing AFM 324 line plays straight away only once 0x01E, 0x01F, 0x020 and 0x021 are all set.

0x020@npc/24.name: castle_thief_wont_go_quietly
0x020@npc/24.summary: Thief vowed 'You'll never take me alive!'
0x020@npc/24.detail: Set in the thief's flight scene. His walk script waits for it and he runs, and when you enter the room again Gwinladin and the Noblewoman stand in new spots. When the scene runs again it plays the fight branch instead ("Time to die").

0x020@npc/42.name: zephyr_heard_darkbeat
0x020@npc/42.detail: Set the first time you talk to Darkbeat on the voyage to Jungo, where he remembers you from Isten and calls Ibkee his sister; after that he only says "You're better off not knowing". It is one of the eight passenger flags (0x01B–0x022) that set 0x023.

0x020@npc/5.name: sanclaria_letter_undelivered
0x020@npc/5.summary: Carrying the Orgo Mayor's letter for Kalan
0x020@npc/5.detail: Set in Orgo (npc/7) when the Mayor gives you the letter. Here, while set, Mayor Kalan takes it, says Orgo has nothing to worry about and pays you; that scene sets 0x004 and clears this flag.

0x020@npc/6.name: orgo_letter_errand
0x020@npc/6.summary: On the Mayor's letter errand to San Claria
0x020@npc/6.detail: Set by the Orgo Mayor (npc/7) and cleared by Mayor Kalan in San Claria (npc/5). While set, Algo, Mary, Meg, the Old Man and the farmer give their errand lines (Mary hands over a Candy Bar snack), and the village's morning trigger stops. Mary also stands at a different spot.

0x020@npc/7.name: orgo_mayor_gave_letter
0x020@npc/7.summary: The Mayor gave you the letter for San Claria
0x020@npc/7.detail: Set (with 0x023) by the Mayor when he sends you to Mayor Kalan in San Claria. While set he only asks you to tell Kalan he is fine, and your bed at home lets you rest. Mayor Kalan clears it (npc/5) when he reads the letter.

0x021@npc/1.name: bonik_gave_terror_seed
0x021@npc/1.summary: Bonik handed over his Terror Seed for free
0x021@npc/1.detail: Set by Bonik at the Coastal Inn at night when flag 0x019 is set and he gives you the Terror Seed (item 16) for free. It is the last of his four freebie flags (0x01E–0x021) that he checks before his AFM 324 line.

0x021@npc/24.name: castle_thief_at_dead_end
0x021@npc/24.summary: Purse thief reached a dead end
0x021@npc/24.detail: A cue in the thief chase during Kalkanor's party, set after "Uh-oh! It's a dead-end!". The thief's walk script waits for it and turns him around. Nothing tests it in a script.

0x021@npc/42.name: zephyr_talked_to_lady
0x021@npc/42.summary: Zephyr: talked to the Lady on deck
0x021@npc/42.detail: Set by the Lady's water-bug line on the voyage to Jungo. It is one of the eight passenger flags that set 0x023 when all are set.

0x021@npc/6.name: orgo_slept_at_home
0x021@npc/6.summary: That night you went to bed at home
0x021@npc/6.detail: Set by your bed at home (npc/7) on the night after leaving the baby; the San Claria inn's bed does not set it. When the night vision on the village path ends, the game warps you to your bedroom if it is set, otherwise to the San Claria inn room.

0x021@npc/7.name: orgo_nightmare_wakeup_due
0x021@npc/7.summary: Slept at home after leaving the baby
0x021@npc/7.detail: Set (with 0x004, 0x097 and 0x0C0) when you go to bed at home on the sad night (0x096). After the night vision returns you to the bedroom, the bedroom's trigger runs the wake-up scene, where your friend asks whether you had a nightmare; that scene sets 0x088 and clears this flag.

0x022@npc/1.name: coastal_inn_sleepless_done
0x022@npc/1.summary: Night at the inn: the 'not tired?' scene has played
0x022@npc/1.detail: Set by the scene that the inn bedroom's trigger runs once Amos's welcome has set 0x004 (with 0x089 set): the companion asks "What? You're not tired?" and the quest log says you can't sleep either. While set, the bedroom trigger stops, so you are free to wander and meet Bonik.

0x022@npc/24.name: castle_thief_cornered
0x022@npc/24.summary: Thief cornered in the throne room
0x022@npc/24.detail: Set at the end of the flight scene. The thief's walk script then re-places him at the cornered spot, Kalkanor and Ramal move close, and the room's trigger starts his fight scene.

0x022@npc/42.name: zephyr_talked_to_traveler
0x022@npc/42.summary: Zephyr: talked to the Traveler about God's Tower
0x022@npc/42.detail: Set when the Traveler on deck says God's Tower is on the Eastern Continent. It is one of the eight passenger flags that set 0x023 when all are set.

0x023@npc/24.name: castle_thief_unused_state
0x023@npc/24.summary: Unused thief state (never set in the castle)
0x023@npc/24.detail: Tested by the throne-room trigger (stop) and by the thief's placement (a spot near the cornered one), but nothing in this pack sets it. It looks like a leftover chase step.

0x023@npc/42.name: zephyr_talked_to_everyone
0x023@npc/42.summary: Zephyr: talked to everyone on board
0x023@npc/42.detail: Set by whichever of the eight passengers (0x01B–0x022) is spoken to last. The deck's trigger then plays "We've walked around the entire ship now", the nap that leads to arrival at Jungo.

0x023@npc/6.name: orgo_baby_wandering
0x023@npc/6.summary: The baby monster still wanders by the village
0x023@npc/6.detail: Set along with the letter (npc/7) and cleared when your companion cries "Look at that cute little monster!" as the Guardian scene begins. The creature placed on the path once the errand is done (actor 11) loops a walk that waits on this flag each lap, so clearing it seems to stop its wandering.

0x023@npc/7.name: orgo_baby_walk_armed
0x023@npc/7.summary: Errand begun; baby monster set to wander
0x023@npc/7.detail: Set together with 0x020 when the Mayor gives you the letter, and never tested in this pack. Outside (npc/6) the baby monster's walk waits on it, and the Guardian scene clears it.

0x024@npc/1.name: coastal_inn_amos_gave_map
0x024@npc/1.summary: Amos gave you Bonik's old magic map
0x024@npc/1.detail: Set by Amos at the Coastal Inn the morning after Bonik leaves (0x006), when he gives you the magic map (Living Toy 1056, Mapster), plays the world-map pins cutscene and sets 0x0F3. After that Amos only offers you a room, and if the Baby is already named he also sets 0x026.

0x024@npc/24.name: castle_thief_attacks
0x024@npc/24.summary: Thief turns to fight: 'Time to die!'
0x024@npc/24.detail: A cue set as the cornered thief's fight scene starts. His walk script waits for it and he charges around the hall. Nothing tests it in a script.

0x024@npc/42.name: zephyr_docked_at_jungo
0x024@npc/42.summary: Zephyr docked at Jungo; you've woken up
0x024@npc/42.detail: Set as the arrival scene starts, when a sailor announces the Zephyr has docked at Jungo and the companion wakes you. On the next deck trigger the companion suggests going to see Jungo, and the exit leads ashore.

0x025@npc/1.name: coastal_inn_baby_named
0x025@npc/1.summary: The Baby has been named at the Coastal Inn
0x025@npc/1.detail: Set by Martha's breakfast scene, where you type the Baby's name. Chapter flag 0x0F9 ('The Journey') is set in the same scene. Afterwards Martha offers paid rest, and if Amos's map is already yours she sets 0x026.

0x025@npc/11.name: zed_ticket_clues_both_seen
0x025@npc/11.summary: No tickets left and heard of the emerald reward
0x025@npc/11.detail: Set by whichever comes second: Bonik buying the last ship ticket (0x002), or overhearing the café customers say the Governor will reward the emerald (0x003). No script, trigger, placement or walk script tests it, so its purpose is unknown.

0x025@npc/24.name: castle_thief_defeated
0x025@npc/24.summary: Purse thief beaten; the King's thanks come next
0x025@npc/24.detail: Set (with 0x0FE) just before the thief battle 0x112, and the thief's last walk step waits for it. Afterwards the thief is gone, another actor (9) appears, the guests regroup, and the trigger plays the King's thanks, which sets 0x095 before the Baby runs off.

0x026@npc/1.name: coastal_inn_ready_to_leave
0x026@npc/1.summary: Got the map and named the Baby: free to leave
0x026@npc/1.detail: Set by whichever of Amos (map, 0x024) or Martha (naming, 0x025) finishes second. Until it is set, the inn's exit only says "We have to say goodbye first". Once set, the exit plays the goodbye to the Weatherbys.

0x026@npc/22.name: trisken_guard_test_underway
0x026@npc/22.summary: Royal Guard test fight is under way
0x026@npc/22.detail: Set when you agree to the Recruiter's test (battle 0x123). Afterwards the trigger restarts him: if 0x0F4 is set (apparently a lost fight) he says to train more; otherwise he praises you, gives Dr. Snooze the first time, and turns you away for being under 18. Either way he clears it.

0x027@npc/1.name: coastal_inn_goodbye_said
0x027@npc/1.summary: Said goodbye to Mr. and Mrs. Weatherby
0x027@npc/1.detail: Set by the inn's exit during the goodbye scene, which writes the quest-log line about a village called Isten to the east. After that the exit warps you straight outside to chunk 7 without the scene.

0x027@npc/22.name: trisken_photo_1_taken
0x027@npc/22.detail: A counter for the Wife who asks you to take their picture: each Yes sets the next of 0x027–0x02B. Nothing else reads it; when all five are set she says they ran out of film.

0x027@npc/42.name: zephyr_storm_chores_done
0x027@npc/42.summary: Storm voyage: passengers checked, chest taken last
0x027@npc/42.detail: Set by the hold's chest (Living Toy 1031) when the storm-voyage Traveler, Lady and seasick Passenger (0x004–0x006) are already done. Then 0x003 is set (by the deck trigger, or by the Captain or Sailor) and you are sent to your cabin, which leads to the storm that ends the voyage.

0x028@npc/1.name: coastal_inn_rescued_after_fall
0x028@npc/1.summary: Amos and Martha found you after the fall
0x028@npc/1.detail: Set at the end of the Cave of Fear fall scene (after its scratch wipe), when Amos and Martha decide to go upstairs and check on you, and the scene warps you to the inn bedroom. There the bedroom trigger runs Amos's wake-up scene, where he says he pulled you out and introduces Bonik.

0x028@npc/2.name: isten_arg_bonik_turns_to_you
0x028@npc/2.summary: Bonik argument: Bonik turns to greet you
0x028@npc/2.detail: A cue in the scene at Isten's gate where Richten's men accuse Bonik: it is set right after "Bonik! What's going on?". Bonik's walk script (actor 17) waits for it and then turns. Nothing tests it in a script.

0x028@npc/22.name: trisken_photo_2_taken
0x028@npc/22.detail: A counter for the Wife who asks you to take their picture: each Yes sets the next of 0x027–0x02B. Nothing else reads it; when all five are set she says they ran out of film.

0x028@npc/45.name: kuldo_saw_kalkanor_party
0x028@npc/45.summary: Kuldo Ruins: caught up with Kalkanor's party
0x028@npc/45.detail: Set in the ruins' last room when the companion recognises the group from Zed Harbor, just before battle 0x104. After it the same scene plays Gwinladin and Kalkanor taking the emerald (0x010), then the companion's 'They took the emerald' (0x007).

0x029@npc/2.name: isten_arg_called_a_liar
0x029@npc/2.summary: Bonik argument: Bonik turns to the 'liar' man
0x029@npc/2.detail: A cue in the scene at Isten's gate, set after Richten's "Are you calling me a liar?". Bonik's walk script (actor 17) waits for it and turns toward him. Nothing tests it in a script.

0x029@npc/22.name: trisken_photo_3_taken
0x029@npc/22.detail: A counter for the Wife who asks you to take their picture: each Yes sets the next of 0x027–0x02B. Nothing else reads it; when all five are set she says they ran out of film.

0x029@npc/42.name: zephyr_phonograph_find
0x029@npc/42.detail: Set (with the lasting 0x19E) the first time you search the phonograph and find something next to the records, then the Captain's script runs. He tells you to keep it, gives item 14 and clears the flag.

0x02A@npc/11.name: zed_snooped_behind_counter
0x02A@npc/11.summary: Just peeked behind a shop counter
0x02A@npc/11.detail: Set by a few spots you are not meant to look into in the inn and the two armorers' shops, which then hand over to the owner's script. There the companion says the owner is "giving us a dirty look" and the flag is cleared at once.

0x02A@npc/2.name: isten_arg_richten_turns
0x02A@npc/2.summary: Bonik argument: Richten turns after Bonik's retort
0x02A@npc/2.detail: A cue in the scene at Isten's gate, set after Bonik says the injury on the same day is strange. Richten's walk script (actor 20) waits for it and turns. Nothing tests it in a script.

0x02A@npc/22.name: trisken_photo_4_taken
0x02A@npc/22.detail: A counter for the Wife who asks you to take their picture: each Yes sets the next of 0x027–0x02B. Nothing else reads it; when all five are set she says they ran out of film.

0x02B@npc/12.name: carmarthen_galik_not_home
0x02B@npc/12.summary: Galik wasn't home; heading for Kuldo
0x02B@npc/12.detail: Set at Galik's door in Carmarthen when nobody answers, along with the quest-log line 'Let's go to Kuldo'. Not tested in this pack, but Rogo's tunnel (npc/41) and the Kuldo swamp (npc/45) test it to move the traveling salesman.

0x02B@npc/2.name: isten_arg_product_liability
0x02B@npc/2.detail: A cue in the scene at Isten's gate, set after Bonik insists this is about product liability. Richten's walk script (actor 20) waits for it and turns. Nothing tests it in a script.

0x02B@npc/22.name: trisken_photo_5_taken
0x02B@npc/22.detail: A counter for the Wife who asks you to take their picture: each Yes sets the next of 0x027–0x02B. This is the last one; after it she says they ran out of film.

0x02B@npc/41.name: tunnel_salesman_gone_out
0x02B@npc/41.summary: Traveling salesman has left Rogo's tunnel
0x02B@npc/41.detail: While set (and before 0x08F or 0x008), the salesman in the tunnel is absent. It is set in Carmarthen (npc/12) when Galik is not home, and a merchant then camps in the Kuldo swamp (npc/45), apparently the same man.

0x02B@npc/45.name: swamp_merchant_camping
0x02B@npc/45.summary: A merchant camps in the Kuldo swamp
0x02B@npc/45.detail: The merchant in the swamp (chunk 113) is placed only while this is set and 0x08F and 0x008 are clear. It is set in Carmarthen (npc/12) when Galik is not home, the same step that empties the tunnel shop in npc/41.

0x02C@npc/2.name: isten_arg_okay_you_win
0x02C@npc/2.summary: Bonik argument: 'Okay, you win' and the men move
0x02C@npc/2.detail: A cue in the scene at Isten's gate, set after Richten says "Okay, you win". Richten's two men (actors 18 and 19) turn and Richten (actor 20) walks a few steps, all through walk scripts that wait for it.

0x02C@npc/41.name: tunnel_salesman_met_in_swamp
0x02C@npc/41.summary: Met the salesman out in the Kuldo swamp
0x02C@npc/41.detail: Set by talking to the merchant in the Kuldo swamp (npc/45). Back in the tunnel the salesman then opens with "Boy am I glad to be back here!" instead of his introduction.

0x02C@npc/45.name: swamp_talked_to_merchant
0x02C@npc/45.summary: Talked to the merchant in the Kuldo swamp
0x02C@npc/45.detail: Set as soon as you speak to the swamp merchant, who offers to keep watch while you sleep. Rogo's tunnel (npc/41) reads it, so the salesman there says he is glad to be back.

0x02D@npc/2.name: isten_arg_like_adults
0x02D@npc/2.summary: Bonik argument: Bonik agrees to talk 'like adults'
0x02D@npc/2.detail: A cue in the scene at Isten's gate, set after Bonik says they can now handle this like adults. The walk scripts of Bonik (actor 17) and Richten (actor 20) wait for it and turn.

0x02E@npc/2.name: isten_bonik_led_away
0x02E@npc/2.summary: Bonik argument: Bonik walks off with Richten's men
0x02E@npc/2.detail: Set (with 0x011) right after Bonik asks you to wait for him. The walk scripts of Bonik and the two men (actors 17–19) wait for it and walk away, and Richten (actor 20) steps up to reveal he has taken Bonik hostage.

0x02F@npc/2.name: isten_fight_get_ready
0x02F@npc/2.summary: Election fight: fighters take their places
0x02F@npc/2.detail: A cue in the election fight's opening, set after the Mayor calls "Fighters: Get ready!". Marco and Richten (actors 12, 13) walk off and the two fighters (Ibkee, actor 11, and actor 16) walk to the ring, all through walk scripts that wait for it.

0x030@npc/2.name: isten_fight_begin
0x030@npc/2.summary: Election fight: 'Let the fight begin!' called
0x030@npc/2.detail: A cue set after the Mayor's "Let the fight begin!". The walk scripts of the two fighters (actors 11 and 16) wait for it and take their last steps, then battle 0x108 starts.

0x031@npc/2.name: isten_marco_farewell_started
0x031@npc/2.detail: Set at the very start of both versions of Marco's farewell, where he catches you before you leave Isten. Nothing tests it (no script, trigger, placement or walk script), and the scene's closing scratch wipe clears it, so it looks unused.

0x032@npc/2.name: isten_wedding_procession_done
0x032@npc/2.summary: Wedding procession over; the party comes next
0x032@npc/2.detail: Set by the Lady's procession scene after Marco and Carmen's wedding: the last walk step of the Mayor, Carmen and Marco (actors 15, 23, 24) waits for it, and after the warp the square's trigger runs the wedding-party scene, with two villagers seated and those three hidden. Marco's farewell also sets it as a cue for Marco (actor 12) to run over, and its closing wipe clears it.

0x032@npc/3.name: isten_carried_from_wedding
0x032@npc/3.summary: Carried back to the inn after the wedding party
0x032@npc/3.detail: Set in npc/2 when the wedding procession ends; the party scene then ends with the Knight carried to the Isten inn. Here the inn's wake-up scene sees it, plays "Wake up! Let's go!", sets 0x0A4 (wedding over) and wipes scratch.

0x033@npc/2.name: isten_marco_gave_directions
0x033@npc/2.summary: Marco gave directions and walks off
0x033@npc/2.detail: Set in Marco's farewell after he explains the way to God's Tower through Zed Harbor. Marco's walk script (actor 12) waits for it and he walks away. The scene then sets 0x087 and wipes scratch.

0x034@npc/3.name: isten_richten_leads_to_fight
0x034@npc/3.summary: Fight morning: Richten leads you to the arena
0x034@npc/3.detail: Set in the inn's morning scene after Richten passes on Bonik's good wishes and the companion says "let's just get this over with". Richten's walk script at the inn (actor 19) waits for it and he walks out, then the scene warps to the arena.

0x035@npc/3.name: isten_resting_after_fight
0x035@npc/3.summary: In bed at the Isten inn, wounded from the fight
0x035@npc/3.detail: Set by the inn's after-fight scene (it runs on 0x013) when the companion tells you to stay in bed. While set, the Keeper and an extra actor (actor 21) stand by the bed, and the next run plays Carmen's visit.

0x036@npc/3.name: isten_carmen_visited_bedside
0x036@npc/3.detail: Set after Carmen blames herself ("I asked him to lose") and the Keeper reassures her. You then sleep, the bedside actors are gone, and the next run plays the healed wake-up.

0x037@npc/3.name: isten_healed_after_fight
0x037@npc/3.summary: Healed after the fight; told Bonik got away
0x037@npc/3.detail: Set when you wake healed: the companion says Bonik escaped and left for Zed Harbor, and the quest log says losing the fight was 'just as well'. While set, the inn's trigger stops, so the after-fight scenes do not repeat.

0x03E@npc/23.name: trisken_bell_swinging
0x03E@npc/23.summary: The big bell is swinging (ring cue)
0x03E@npc/23.detail: Set, then cleared a moment later, when you ring the big bell in chunk 376 once 0x091 is set; before that it 'seems to be broken'. The bell's walk script waits on this flag and then turns, so it seems to drive the swing, and the scene ends on "What a pure tone!".

0x041.name: garam_old_woman_told_tale
0x041.summary: Garam's Old Woman told you her current tale
0x041.detail: Old Woman (npc/26, chunk 280) sets it after her one-time story in each phase: the legend of the white Giant, Kalkanor's tall tale of slaying it, the news that Kalkanor fell at God's Tower, and finally her question about the worm in the sky. Kalkanor's scene in the Giant's cave (npc/27, sets 0x08A) and Aruvin's scene (npc/31, sets 0x09D) clear it so the line plays again in the next phase. Nothing clears it at 0x0E6, so if you heard her chapter 3 line she skips the worm question.

0x042.name: garam_billy_confessed
0x042.summary: Billy admitted he left Ann in the cave
0x042.detail: Set when Billy (npc/26) first tells you he ran from the monster and left Ann behind, before the Giant dies. While set, a nearby villager laughs it off as Billy's tall tale instead of talking about the sealed cave. Cleared by Aruvin's chapter 3 scene (npc/31).

0x043.name: garam_rockslide_worker_talked
0x043.summary: Rockslide worker explained the blocked Denvrado road
0x043.detail: The villager clearing the rockslide (npc/26 actor 12) explains once, before the Giant dies, that the quake blocked the road to Denvrado and he needs days off; afterwards he only repeats his refusal. Cleared by Aruvin's chapter 3 scene (npc/31).

0x044.name: garam_toy_fan_talked
0x044.summary: Garam villager talked about Living Toys
0x044.detail: Villager (npc/26 actor 2) sets it after his first Living Toy talk in each phase: before the Giant dies he asks to see a Living Toy and wanders off to find some, after it he lists the ways to find them. Kalkanor's scene in the Giant's cave (npc/27, sets 0x08A) and Aruvin's scene (npc/31, sets 0x09D) clear it so the line plays again in the next phase.

0x045.name: garam_ann_father_went_to_ann
0x045.summary: Ann's father heard the Giant died and ran to Ann
0x045.detail: Set by Ann's Father (npc/26) when you talk to him after the Giant is killed (0x08A); he hurries off. While set he and Ann stand together in chunk 282 and Ann leaves the Giant's cave (npc/27 chunk 460); talking to him again sends them home (0x047). Cleared by Kalkanor's and Aruvin's scenes.

0x046.name: garam_woman_news_heard
0x046.summary: Garam woman shared her news (quake or Giant)
0x046.detail: Woman (npc/26 actor 11) sets it after her one-time line: before the Giant dies, the strong earthquake and landslide; after it, that the Trisken knight killed the Giant. Kalkanor's scene in the Giant's cave (npc/27, sets 0x08A) and Aruvin's scene (npc/31, sets 0x09D) clear it so the line plays again in the next phase. The engine also sets it right after the flag reset in GameMode_RootTask mode 13 (the new game's opening battle with the Baby); the scripts give it no other meaning.
0x046.engine: Root mode 13 (reset for a new game, then go straight into a battle with the Baby in the party) sets 0x46 right after the reset. No retail code requests mode 13, so this looks like a debug/test leftover; the scripts use 0x46 for unrelated dialogue state (npc/26, 27, 31).

0x047.name: garam_ann_taken_home
0x047.detail: Set when you talk to Ann's Father again after 0x045; he and Ann walk home. While set Ann and her mother stand inside their house (npc/27 chunk 353), and her mother thanks Kalkanor instead of praying Ann is alive. Aruvin's chapter 3 scene clears it, but by then 0x098 keeps the same placements.

0x048.name: garam_rancher_knoygn_talk
0x048.summary: Garam Rancher talked about his Knoygns
0x048.detail: Rancher (npc/27, chunk 349) sets it after his one-time Knoygn line in each phase: they are livestock, not pests (before the Giant dies); they bleated when it died; and in chapter 3 a remark about raising your own Knoygn. Kalkanor's scene in the Giant's cave (npc/27, sets 0x08A) and Aruvin's scene (npc/31, sets 0x09D) clear it so the line plays again in the next phase.

0x049.name: garam_villager_trisken_talk
0x049.summary: Garam villager described the Trisken group
0x049.detail: Villager (npc/26 actor 10) sets it after his one-time line: after the Giant dies, the Trisken party passing through with a cheerful old man; in chapter 3, two badly hurt Trisken men carried past by Aruvin's helper. Kalkanor's scene in the Giant's cave (npc/27, sets 0x08A) and Aruvin's scene (npc/31, sets 0x09D) clear it so the line plays again in the next phase.

0x04A.name: orgo_mayor_farewell_given
0x04A.summary: Orgo Mayor gave his God's Tower farewell
0x04A.detail: Set by the Mayor of Orgo (npc/7) the first time you see him in chapter 2: he sees you found your little friend and tells you to take it to God's Tower. Afterwards he only says goodbye. Aruvin's chapter 3 scene (npc/31) clears it, so he repeats the speech in chapter 3 until 0x0E6.

0x04B.name: ch2_chatter_reserved_04b
0x04B.summary: Unused; cleared with the Garam chatter flags
0x04B.detail: Never set or tested. Its only reference is the clear in Aruvin's scene (npc/31) that resets 0x041 to 0x04B when chapter 3 begins.

0x04E.name: den_heldar_historian_tip_bought
0x04E.summary: Bought the Historian's secret-door tip (100 rubies)
0x04E.detail: Set when you pay the Historian in Den Heldar (npc/14, chunk 182) 100 rubies for his North Tower tip: explore the whole tower to find the secret door. Once the tower is cleared he then asks whether you found it where he said, instead of sulking or giving the tip away free.

0x04F.name: gamella_asked_rescue_mayor
0x04F.summary: Gamella asked you to rescue her father the Mayor
0x04F.detail: Set by Gamella (npc/15, chunk 348) when she begs you to rescue her father from the North Tower; it adds the rescue objective. It stops the chunk 146 scene where your companion refuses to enter the tower, and Den Heldar townsfolk then urge you to save the Mayor.

0x050.name: den_heldar_revisited_mid_rescue
0x050.summary: Returned to Den Heldar before Jadik was rescued
0x050.detail: A trigger in Den Heldar (npc/14, chunk 182) sets it whenever you enter town after the townspeople are freed (0x090) but before Jadik (0x091). Once Jadik is saved, townsfolk use their second-visit lines instead of first thanks, the innkeeper says his Trisken guest paid, and Gamella stands elsewhere (npc/15).

0x052.name: den_heldar_cold_citizen_talked
0x052.summary: Den Heldar citizen blamed outsiders for his cold
0x052.detail: Set by a Den Heldar citizen (npc/14 actor 5) after Kalkanor's defeat (0x092) when he first blames outsiders for colds. Afterwards each talk is a sneezing gag that toggles scratch flag 0x007.

0x053.name: trisken_flower_girl_rose_bought
0x053.summary: Bought a rose from Trisken's Flower Girl
0x053.detail: Set by the Flower Girl (npc/22, chunk 272) when you agree to buy her first 300-ruby rose; she asks your name. Afterwards she greets you by name and offers a rose or a lily.

0x054.name: trisken_runaway_baby_found
0x054.summary: Runaway Baby found again (never set; lines unused)
0x054.detail: Tested by six Trisken townsfolk (npc/22) and Maris (npc/23) after the Baby runs off (0x095) to pick a 'you found your pig' line over directions to the Eastern Pass. No script or trigger sets it, and finding the Baby at the gate sets 0x08C, which those NPCs check first, so the found lines never play.

0x055.name: trisken_cafe_fee_paid
0x055.summary: Paid the 3000-ruby entrance at Trisken's shady cafe
0x055.detail: Set by the cafe Doorman (npc/22, chunk 270) when you pay his 3000-ruby entrance fee. After 0x090 he apologizes for last time and says the cafe has a new owner instead of his usual pitch.

0x056.name: trisken_gym_owner_pitched
0x056.summary: MTC owner already pitched you (never set)
0x056.detail: The Monster Training Center owner (npc/22 actor 9) tests it in every phase to say 'I knew you'd come back' instead of his welcome pitch. No script or trigger sets it, so the welcome always plays; the intended meaning is inferred from that line.

0x057.name: trisken_wallet_found
0x057.summary: Picked up the lost wallet in Trisken
0x057.detail: Set when a Trisken resident (npc/22 actor 12) hands you a wallet he found (item 513), after 0x090. It lets the Tourist who lost it take it back (0x05D); afterwards the resident has other lines.

0x059.name: trisken_king_welcomed_heroes
0x059.detail: Set by the King's welcome scene in the throne room (npc/24, chunk 397), which plays once Kalkanor has returned. It opens the castle doors in chunk 271, stops the castle-entry scenes (npc/22, npc/24) and moves Kalkanor, Ramal, Gwinladin and a noblewoman.

0x05A.name: trisken_east_gate_first_visit
0x05A.summary: Baby sensed something beyond the Eastern Pass gate
0x05A.detail: Set by the auto scene on your first visit to the Eastern Pass gate (npc/22, chunk 274): the Baby reacts to something out there, then you head back. Afterwards that trigger runs the guards' 'none shall pass' scene instead, and the Old Man on the road talks about monsters beyond the gate.

0x05B.name: trisken_tourist_paid_500
0x05B.summary: Tourist paid you 500 rubies to go away
0x05B.detail: Set when the tourist couple (npc/22, chunk 271) first catch you staring and Bobby pays you 500 rubies to leave. The next talk pays 1000 (0x05C).

0x05C.name: trisken_tourist_paid_1000
0x05C.summary: Tourist paid you 1000 more rubies to go away
0x05C.detail: Set on the second talk with the tourist couple (npc/22, chunk 271) after 0x05B, when Bobby pays you another 1000. The next talk has him take money back (0x060).

0x05D.name: trisken_wallet_returned
0x05D.summary: Returned the lost wallet to its owner
0x05D.detail: Set by the Tourist who lost his wallet (npc/22 actor 21, chunk 270) when you hold it (0x057); you hand it over either way, for 1000 rubies if you agree or 500 if your companion makes you. Afterwards he thanks you and stands in a new spot.

0x05F.name: denvrado_aruvin_cure_done
0x05F.detail: A Denvrado villager (npc/28) who thought you looked sick asks, after you meet Aruvin (0x098), whether he cured you; this flag picks 'you look better' over 'you didn't get cured'. No script or trigger sets it, so only the not-cured line plays.

0x060.name: trisken_tourist_took_money_back
0x060.summary: Tourist took his money back (1500 rubies)
0x060.detail: Set on the third talk with the tourist couple (npc/22, chunk 271) after 0x05C: Bobby demands his money back and takes 1500 rubies, or all you have. Afterwards he just tells you to beat it.

0x061.name: trisken_alt_street_state
0x061.summary: Unused alternate street state in later Trisken
0x061.detail: Never set by any script or trigger. In npc/21 (Trisken after 0x0E6) it would replace the street auto scene in chunks 270/272 with one that only wipes scratch flags, and in npc/21 and npc/25 it moves the Flower Girl and Old Man.

0x062.name: north_tower_secret_passage_seen
0x062.summary: Saw something slip into the North Tower's secret passage
0x062.detail: Set by the North Tower scene (npc/44, chunk 439, or its copy for actor 2) where your companion sees something vanish into a secret passage and says to follow it. It stops that scene from replaying and removes its actor; the scene only runs after 0x064.

0x063.name: north_tower_met_darkbeat
0x063.summary: Met Darkbeat and Ibkee in the North Tower
0x063.detail: Set at the end of the North Tower scene (npc/44, chunk 441) where you startle Darkbeat and Ibkee and they charge ahead to free the townspeople. It stops the scene and removes them from that room; a Den Heldar citizen (npc/14) also drops your companion's remark about the yellow dinosaur.

0x064.name: north_tower_empty_room_found
0x064.summary: Found the North Tower's room empty of captives
0x064.detail: Set by the North Tower scene (npc/44, chunk 438) where the party finds nobody and wonders where the Mayor is. It stops that scene, switches the door sets in chunks 434/435 and enables the secret-passage scene in chunk 439 (0x062). An unused copy of the Cave of Fear farewell in npc/1 (actor 10, never placed) also sets it.

0x065.name: isten_carmen_asked_find_marco
0x065.summary: Carmen asked you to find Marco
0x065.detail: Set by Carmen (npc/3, chunk 370) in chapter 2 when she tells you Marco went to the temple to complain and never came back. Afterwards she just repeats her plea until 0x0A4, when she thanks you for the wedding.

0x066.name: isten_cult_refuser_talked
0x066.summary: Isten villager told of refusing the cult
0x066.detail: Set by a villager in Isten (npc/3, chunk 366, present in chapter 2 until 0x0A4) after he says he turned down the cult. Afterwards he says everyone stays inside to escape the chanting.

0x067.name: isten_fur_tunic_talk
0x067.summary: Isten villager talked about fur fish tunics
0x067.detail: Set by a villager in Isten (npc/2, chunk 48) after 0x0A4 when he mentions a Clarian fur fish tunic he saw in Zed Harbor. Afterwards he just praises Clarian pelts.

0x068.name: isten_old_lady_saw_marco
0x068.summary: Old Lady said she saw Marco taken at the church
0x068.detail: Set by the frightened Old Lady (npc/3, chunk 374) who watched something happen to Marco at the church. While set, the temple Follower (npc/2) is caught holding Marco and you confront him (0x07B) instead of being told services are on.

0x069.name: jungo_cafe_entering
0x069.summary: Jungo cafe Doorman is letting you in (transient)
0x069.detail: Set by the cafe Doorman on Jungo (npc/34, chunk 162) when he lets you in (before 0x0E6 the Baby waits outside). The door actor then clears it, hides the Knight and warps him into the cafe (chunk 375); without it, touching the door hands over to the Doorman's script.

0x06A.name: isten_wedding_vows_done
0x06A.summary: Marco and Carmen's wedding vows are done
0x06A.detail: Set at the end of the wedding ceremony in Isten (npc/2, chunk 48, auto-started by 0x0A7) when the Mayor calls everyone to celebrate. While set, the chunk 48 trigger plays the procession scene that leads to the party (via scratch 0x032), and the guests and couple stand in new places.

0x06B.name: penguii_mayor_thought_santa
0x06B.summary: Penguii Mayor mistook you for Santa
0x06B.detail: Set by the Mayor of Penguii (npc/32, chunk 61) the first time he greets you as Santa. Afterwards Tongie jokes that the Mayor thought you were Santa instead of pointing him out.

0x06C.name: san_claria_richten_story_told
0x06C.summary: Richten explained why he works at the San Claria inn
0x06C.detail: Set by Richten at the San Claria inn (npc/5, chunk 329, present from chapter 2) after he explains the cult took his money once he lost the Isten election. Afterwards he only says the work has humbled him.

0x06D.name: trisken_bell_ringing
0x06D.summary: Big bell is ringing (held for ~195 frames)
0x06D.detail: Set when you ring the big bell in Trisken (npc/23, chunk 376) after Jadik is home (0x091), between the two bell sounds, and cleared about 195 frames later. No script tests it, so whatever reads it (probably the bell's animation) lies outside the scripts.

0x06E.name: picard_holy_armor_worn
0x06E.summary: Knight put on the Holy Armor
0x06E.detail: Set in Picard (npc/9, chunk 408) in chapter 4 when the Holy Armor refuses Darkbeat and the Knight puts it on. It makes the chunk 408 trigger start Darkbeat's legendary-Warrior scene, which sets 0x06F.

0x06F.name: picard_holy_armor_transport
0x06F.summary: Holy Armor sent the Knight away; arrival next
0x06F.detail: Set at the end of Darkbeat's legendary-Warrior scene in Picard (npc/9), which removes a helper actor, hides the Knight (0x0FF) and reloads chunk 408. The trigger then plays Darkbeat's 'They're... gone!', which sets 0x0A0 and warps the Knight to chunk 343.

0x070.name: san_claria_inn_welcome_back
0x070.summary: San Claria inn keeper welcomed you back (free rooms)
0x070.detail: Set by the San Claria inn keeper (npc/5, chunk 329) in chapter 2 when the keeper greets you back from your adventures, mentions a new helper and offers a free room. Afterwards the keeper just offers the free room.

0x071.name: warp_gate_first_remark
0x071.summary: Saw a Warp Gate for the first time
0x071.detail: Set by the scene in any Warp Gate chamber (npc/8) where your companion guesses the Warp Gate Key is needed; the scene runs only after 0x085. It stops that scene in all seven gate chunks.

0x072.name: jungo_bonique_greeted
0x072.summary: Bonik greeted you at his Jungo shop Bonique
0x072.detail: Set by Bonik (npc/35, chunk 383) on your first visit to his shop, when he recognizes you and complains that no ships stop on Jungo anymore. Afterwards he just greets you and asks you to buy something.

0x073.name: garam_ann_father_pleaded
0x073.summary: Ann's father begged you to save Ann from the Giant
0x073.detail: Set by Ann's Father (npc/26) in the auto scene in chunk 282, or on talking to him, when he explains Ann is trapped with a Giant; it adds the rescue objective. It stops the auto scene (the trigger only wipes scratch flags), and he then just pleads; everything stops once the Giant dies (0x08A).

0x074.name: amos_blue_cat_told
0x074.summary: Amos told you about the stray blue cat
0x074.detail: Set by Amos (npc/1, chunk 342) in chapter 2 after he mentions a stray blue cat that wanders in and out of the house. Afterwards he just invites you back.

0x076.name: penguii_apple_taken
0x076.summary: Took the apple in the Penguii Mayor's house
0x076.detail: Set when you take the apple (item 6) in the Penguii Mayor's house (npc/33, chunk 351) and feel guilty. Afterwards the spot has nothing of interest.

0x077.name: isten_hidden_item_found
0x077.summary: Found the hidden item in an Isten house
0x077.detail: Set when searching a spot in an Isten interior (npc/3, chunk 378) turns up item 188, which your companion thinks flew in. Afterwards nothing unusual is found; item 188 is also the bug from the Zephyr's crate (0x079).

0x078.name: kerple_post_dug
0x078.summary: Dug up the item at the base of a Kerple post
0x078.detail: Set when digging at the base of a post in Kerple (npc/18, chunk 258) gives item 12. Afterwards you only get dirty hands.

0x079.name: zephyr_apple_taken
0x079.summary: Took an apple from the Zephyr's hold; bug not found yet
0x079.detail: Set when you take an apple (item 6) from a sack in the Zephyr's hold (npc/42, chunk 419) before reaching Jungo (0x08F). After arrival, the wooden crate gives a bug (item 188) only while it is set, then clears it.

0x07A.name: gods_tower_arrival_remark
0x07A.detail: Set by the scene on first reaching God's Tower (npc/30, chunk 174), where your companion says the long journey is over and the objective changes. It stops that scene from replaying.

0x07B.name: isten_follower_confronted
0x07B.summary: Confronted the temple Follower holding Marco
0x07B.detail: Set at the Isten temple (npc/2, chunk 48) when, after the Old Lady's report (0x068), you tell the Follower to let go of Marco. Afterwards the Follower only shouts at you to stay where you are.

0x07C.name: shrine_chest_495_opened
0x07C.summary: Opened the chest in the Holy Armor shrine (chunk 495)
0x07C.detail: Set when you open the chest in a Holy Armor shrine (npc/43, chunk 495) and get item 4. The chest then shows as empty and is not placed on later visits.

0x07E.name: owl_shrine_chest_476_opened
0x07E.summary: Opened the chest in the Know Owl shrine (chunk 476)
0x07E.detail: The chest in the Holy Armor shrine with the Know Owl (npc/16, chunk 476) uses this as its own chest flag for item 4. Once set it shows as empty and is not placed on later visits.

0x081.name: orgo_baby_to_cave_ordered
0x081.summary: Mayor ordered Baby taken to the Cave of Fear
0x081.detail: Set when the Knight wakes the morning after the Mayor's order (npc/7 Knight's house, "I guess it was just an illusion") and set again by the stranger's dream in Orgo square (npc/6). While set, Orgo and San Claria folk comment on the pink "pig", the Mayor repeats his order, the Cave of Fear mouth plays the goodbye scene (npc/1) and Orgo's day-one scenes stop. Resting after leaving Baby (0x096) clears it for that one night, which puts Orgo in its night state with the villagers gone.

0x082.name: kell_mushmare_defeated
0x082.summary: Kell freed from Mushmare; the Elder thanked you
0x082.detail: Set by the Kell Elder (npc/40, chunk 403) when he thanks you after the Mushmare battle; the next Elder scene introduces Mr. O'Neal, who swaps the old toys you found for living toys. While set, Kell's guards and Elder move and change lines (the Elder points you to the inner caves), extra exits open in chunks 403 and 412, and the old-toy chests in Orgo (npc/7), San Claria (npc/5) and Kell give the living toy directly.

0x083.name: kell_baby_found_in_bird_nest
0x083.summary: Found Baby in the giant bird's nest; the bird woke
0x083.detail: Set in Kell's inner caves (npc/40 actor 23, chunk 340) when you find Baby asleep in a nest and the bird wakes, just before the bird battle. After the fight you flee with the Heavy Stone, and back at the Cave of Fear mouth (npc/1, chunk 42) it starts the scene where you fall into the river (0x089).

0x084.name: coastal_inn_martha_paid
0x084.detail: Set at the Coastal Inn (npc/1, chunk 342) the first time you insist on paying Martha 20 rubies for a night, which is possible once Baby has been named. Later paid stays play the short "Thank you very much" exchange instead of her long thank-you.

0x085.name: picard_warp_gate_key
0x085.summary: Darkbeat gave you the Warp Gate Key
0x085.detail: Set by Darkbeat in Picard (npc/9, chunk 408) when he hands over the Warp Gate Key (item 185; the chest uses 0x085 as its flag) and asks you to find the Holy Armor. While set, the Warp Gates in the Guardian shrines teleport you (npc/16, 19, 43, 46), gate rooms play a first-visit hint (npc/8), the companion's remark at each gate changes, and Picard's library scenes advance.

0x086.name: chapter_2_wider_worlds
0x086.detail: Set by the Kerple Chief (npc/19, chunk 387) when he gives you the Chester Flute for beating Yugonga; the save screen names the chapter from the first of 0xAB, 0x9D, 0x86, 0xF9 that is set. Over 160 sites read it: Orgo, San Claria, Isten, the Coastal Inn, Kell, Zed Harbor and Kerple switch to their later dialogue and placements, and the chapter-1 and Kerple scenes stop.
0x086.engine: Chapter 2 flag. The chapter title shown at the bottom of the field menu and written into the memory-card save as its location name is the first of 0xAB, 0x9D, 0x86, 0xF9 that is set; 0x86 picks 'Wider Worlds'.

0x087.name: isten_marco_sent_to_zed_harbor
0x087.summary: Marco won Isten's election; you head for Zed Harbor
0x087.detail: Set by Marco after the Isten election fight, in the square (npc/2) or in his house (npc/3), when he pays you 500 rubies and points you east to Zed Harbor. While set, the election crowd, the bookie and Richten's bodyguards leave Isten, Richten's house plays its empty-house check (0x08D), and the Coastal Inn (npc/1) stays in its paid-stay state.

0x088.name: resolved_to_rescue_baby
0x088.summary: Resolved to go back to the Cave of Fear for Baby
0x088.detail: Set when the Knight wakes from the stranger's dream, at home in Orgo (npc/7 actor 1) or at the San Claria inn (npc/5 actor 1). While set, the dream and day-one triggers in Orgo and San Claria stop, beds give a normal rest, and the Cave of Fear mouth (npc/1) plays the "Are you sure you want to go in" scene.

0x089.name: fell_into_river_from_cave
0x089.summary: Fell into the river while fleeing the Cave of Fear
0x089.detail: Set in the escape scene at the Cave of Fear mouth (npc/1 actor 1, chunk 42), just before the Knight and his companion fall and Amos and Martha find them. While set, the Cave of Fear mouth's scenes stop, Bonik stands in the Coastal Inn (npc/1) and Kell's chunk-386 trigger (npc/40) stops.

0x08A.name: garam_ruval_gem_taken
0x08A.summary: Kalkanor took Ruval's gem; Ann is safe
0x08A.detail: Set in Ruval's cave east of Garam (npc/27, chunk 460) after you fight Kalkanor's party and they leave with the last gem for God's Tower. While set, the cave scenes stop, Ann mourns Ruval, the Mayor admits he was wrong about the Giant, and Garam's people (npc/26, npc/27) switch to their after-the-Giant lines.

0x08B.name: baby_flew_party_out
0x08B.summary: Baby flew everyone out of God's Tower
0x08B.detail: Set in God's Tower (npc/30 actor 20, chunk 415) when the wounded Darkbeat tells Ibkee to fly out and Baby offers its own back; the escape plays as a cutscene and drops you in Picard. No script tests it; the engine reads 0x08B, most likely so that Baby can carry the Knight from then on.
0x08B.engine: While set, the Baby's sub-menu shows a fourth row, 'Fly' (ride on the Baby's back), greyed off the overworld, on the water bug, on zone 0xBB or while 0xF0 is set. Choosing it wipes scratch flags 0–63 and starts the flight mode.

0x08C.name: trisken_eastern_gate_opened
0x08C.summary: Trisken's King opened the Eastern Pass gate
0x08C.detail: Set by the King at the Eastern Pass gate (npc/22 actor 45, chunk 274) after Baby runs there and he orders free passage. While set, the gate guards step aside, Trisken's residents talk about Kalkanor setting out after Karmine, and Kalkanor's party is gone from the castle (npc/24).

0x08D.name: isten_richten_fled
0x08D.summary: Found Richten's house empty after the election
0x08D.detail: Set the first time you enter Richten's house in Isten (npc/3 actor 10, chunk 374) after the election, when your companion notes that he has run away. It only stops that house trigger from repeating.

0x08E.name: isten_gambler_ranted
0x08E.summary: Heard the Isten gambler's rant about the bookie
0x08E.detail: Set by the Gambler in Isten's square (npc/2 actor 10) after the election, when he complains that the bookie skipped town with everyone's money. Afterwards he only repeats his advice not to gamble.

0x08F.name: jungo_reached
0x08F.detail: Set by the Jungo town trigger (npc/34, chunk 162) on your first arrival. On the Zephyr (npc/42) it switches the crew and passengers to the stormy next leg that ends in the shipwreck at Kerple, and it retires earlier scenes in Zed Harbor (npc/11), the Governor's house (npc/48), Rogo's dig (npc/41) and the Winged Lion scene (npc/45).

0x090.name: den_heldar_captives_freed
0x090.summary: Freed the Den Heldar captives in the North Tower
0x090.detail: Set in the North Tower (npc/44 actor 6, chunk 442) after you and Darkbeat beat the Red and Blue Monsters and the Mayor and other Heldarians go free; the scene ends with a plea to save the man from Trisken still inside. While set, the tower's earlier scenes stop, Den Heldar celebrates with its Mayor home (npc/14, npc/15), and tourists fill Trisken (npc/22, npc/23); Penguii's Mayor (npc/32) also uses it as a milestone.

0x091.name: jadik_rescued_solomons_ring
0x091.summary: Rescued Jadik and took Solomon's Ring
0x091.detail: Set in the depths of the North Tower (npc/44 actor 20, chunk 445) when you open the chest holding Solomon's Ring (0x091 is its chest flag) after the Guardian fight, and Jadik thanks you. While set, Den Heldar's lines change again, its innkeeper says Jadik paid and wants you to visit him in Trisken, and Trisken holds Kalkanor's homecoming parade.

0x092.name: gods_tower_kalkanor_felled
0x092.detail: Set by Ramal's dying words at the barrier outside God's Tower (npc/37 actor 3, chunk 413) after Gwinladin is unmasked as Glor and beaten; a trigger in chunk 521 (npc/31) also sets it before moving you into God's Tower. While set, Aruvin wakes and his shrine plays the scene that starts chapter 3 (npc/31), Trisken's gate guards and lookout mourn Kalkanor (npc/22, npc/20), and Kalkanor's party is gone from the castle (npc/24).

0x093.name: trisken_waitress_hidden
0x093.summary: Unused: would hide the Trisken cafe waitress
0x093.detail: No script sets 0x093; it is only read by placements. While set, the waitress in the Trisken cafe (npc/23, chunk 372) would be absent; npc/21's actor 17 is absent either way.

0x095.name: trisken_thief_caught
0x095.summary: Caught the castle thief; Baby ran off
0x095.detail: Set by the King at Trisken Castle (npc/24 actor 1, chunk 397) when he thanks you for catching the purse thief, just before Baby bolts. While set, Trisken's people point you to the Eastern Pass and the King waits at the gate for the 0x08C scene (npc/22), Aki is back home (npc/23) and gone from Jungo, and the noblewoman rewards you.

0x096.name: baby_left_at_cave_of_fear
0x096.summary: Baby abandoned at the Cave of Fear
0x096.detail: Set by the goodbye scene at the Cave of Fear mouth (npc/1 actor 11, chunk 42), when Baby wanders into the cave. While set, Orgo and San Claria folk ask about the Knight's long face, the companion leads you home from the cave, and the next rest at home (npc/7) or at the San Claria inn (npc/5) starts the stranger's dream (0x097) unless 0x088 is set.

0x097.name: stranger_dream_night
0x097.summary: Slept after leaving Baby; the stranger's dream plays
0x097.detail: Set when you rest at home in Orgo (npc/7 beds) or at the San Claria inn (npc/5) after leaving Baby, alongside 0x0C0 and the night-time scratch flags. It makes Orgo square (npc/6 actor 11) play the stranger's message to take Baby to its mother in God's Tower, then returns you to bed, where the San Claria inn runs its wake-up scene. Never cleared; 0x088 stops both triggers.

0x098.name: aruvin_met_asleep
0x098.detail: Set when you talk to the sleeping Aruvin at his shrine (npc/31 actor 3, chunk 344). It unlocks the scene outside God's Tower where Karmine confronts Kalkanor (npc/37), brings Ann and her parents home in Garam (npc/26, npc/27), and switches the nearby village (npc/28, npc/29) to later lines.

0x099.name: holy_shield_taken
0x099.summary: Took the Holy Shield from its Guardian shrine
0x099.detail: Set when you open the Guardian's chest in the shrine with Jengie (npc/46, chunk 459; item 160, chest flag 0x099), probably the shrine near Penguii, whose Mayor (npc/32) then asks about your treasure. Each Holy Armor chest checks the other three pieces and sets chapter 4 (0x0AB) once all are found; until then the objective counts the pieces left.

0x09A.name: holy_helmet_taken
0x09A.summary: Took the Holy Helmet from Kerple's shrine
0x09A.detail: Set when you open the Guardian's chest in Kerple's shrine (npc/19 actor 13, chunk 452; item 126, chest flag 0x09A). The Kerpleans' lines about the holy treasure change, and like the other pieces it sets chapter 4 (0x0AB) when it completes the set.

0x09B.name: holy_sword_taken
0x09B.summary: Took the Holy Sword from Know Owl's castle
0x09B.detail: Set when you open the Guardian's chest at the heart of Know Owl's castle (npc/16 actor 8, chunk 492; item 52, chest flag 0x09B). Like the other pieces it updates the objective count and sets chapter 4 (0x0AB) when it completes the set.

0x09C.name: holy_armor_taken
0x09C.summary: Took the Holy Armor body piece from its shrine
0x09C.detail: Set when you open the Guardian's chest in the npc/43 shrine (chunk 497; item 106 Holy Armor, chest flag 0x09C); its dialogue never names the place. Like the other pieces it updates the objective count and sets chapter 4 (0x0AB) when it completes the set.

0x09D.name: chapter_3_the_destiny
0x09D.detail: Set by Aruvin at his shrine (npc/31 actor 6, chunk 344) after Baby says something terrible will happen at God's Tower and Aruvin gives you a living toy (item 1000); the save screen names the chapter from the first of 0xAB, 0x9D, 0x86, 0xF9 that is set. While set, Kalkanor and Ramal rest in Trisken Castle and the King rewards you (npc/24), the shrine scene stops, and Garam switches to later lines.
0x09D.engine: Chapter 3 flag. The save/field-menu chapter title is the first of 0xAB, 0x9D, 0x86, 0xF9 that is set; 0x9D picks 'The Destiny'.

0x09E.name: zed_harbor_bosmie_confronted
0x09E.summary: Saved Zed Harbor from Bosmie's monster raid
0x09E.detail: Set in monster-raided Zed Harbor (npc/39 actor 13, chunk 87) when you corner the ringleader Bosmie, just before his battle. While set, the gargoyles are gone and townsfolk talk about Xizan, the inn is free (npc/11), and the Governor's household thanks you (npc/48).
0x09E.engine: Inlined bit test in the overworld music/hotspot task: on Zed Harbor chunks 87/89, standing in map zone 0x0E while 0xE6 is set starts actor 42's scene (the cult-raid alarm), unless 0x9E or 0xEF is set. So 0x9E stops the Zed Harbor raid from starting again.

0x0A0.name: holy_armor_chose_knight
0x0A0.summary: Holy Armor chose the Knight; party sent to Darwin
0x0A0.detail: Set in Picard (npc/9, Darkbeat actor 1) after the Knight puts on the Holy Armor (0x06E, 0x06F) and the party finds itself alone, with the quest line "Did the Holy Armor transport us here?"; it then warps to Darwin's throne room (chunk 343). While set, Picard's auto-scenes stop and Darkbeat only says it is up to you now, and in npc/38 Darwin appears and his challenge starts on arrival. The quest line written after the Org (Trisken, npc/21) and Bosmie (Zed Harbor, npc/39) encounters says the Holy Armor chose you until 0x0A1.

0x0A1.name: darwin_test_fought
0x0A1.summary: Darwin's final test fought; preparing for the last battle
0x0A1.detail: Set by Darwin (npc/38 actor 3, chunk 343) just before battle 0x11B, after he says you have one more test to pass. While set, that Darwin is removed and the room trigger plays the follow-up: Darwin restores HP/MP, says you have proven your worthiness and offers to send you to Xizan's storm cloud. The quest line (Darwin, and the Org/Bosmie encounters in npc/21, npc/39) becomes preparing for the final battle.

0x0A2.name: zeppetto_met
0x0A2.summary: Met Zeppetto Jr. on Zeppetto Island
0x0A2.detail: Set on the first talk with Zeppetto Jr. in his workshop (npc/36, chunk 346), after O'Neal greets him as Professor Zeppetto. While set, later talks skip the introduction: with every Living Toy found (0x0F6) he plays the farewell scene, otherwise he comments on your collection (0x095) or on your trip to God's Tower.

0x0A3.name: zeppetto_ghost_departed
0x0A3.summary: Showed Zeppetto every Living Toy; his ghost departed
0x0A3.detail: Set at the end of the Zeppetto Jr. scene in npc/36 when you own all Living Toys (0x0F6): he hands over Legend (item 1036), his final masterpiece, and fades away as O'Neal realises he was a ghost. While set, Zeppetto Jr. and his two helper actors are absent from the workshop.

0x0A4.name: isten_wedding_over
0x0A4.summary: Marco and Carmen's wedding is over
0x0A4.detail: Set by the Isten inn Keeper (npc/3 actor 1) when he wakes you after the wedding party (scratch 0x032 from the npc/2 party scene), together with wipe_scratch. While set, the Isten scene triggers stop (chunks 48, 366, 378), villagers move back and talk about Bonik's San Claria ad campaign, Carmen and Mayor Marco each offer the wedding gift Marilyn (item 1070), and the Artema church door just lets you walk in and out.

0x0A5.name: picard_holy_armor_hunt
0x0A5.summary: Got the Warp Gate Key; the Holy Armor hunt has begun
0x0A5.detail: Set by Darkbeat in Picard (npc/9 actors 1 and 2) once he has handed over the Warp Gate Key (item 185, 0x085) and the library has been searched (scratch 0x009), with the quest line "We can't give up now" and wipe_scratch. While set, Picard's auto-scenes stop (chunks 408 and 409), the library books no longer count progress, Ibkee moves and a Picardian greets you as guardians of knowledge.

0x0A7.name: isten_marco_rescued
0x0A7.summary: Marco rescued from the Isten cult; wedding day
0x0A7.detail: Set when the cult Gargoyle in Isten's Artema church (npc/3 actor 20, chunk 378) attacks (battle 0x120, which also clears 0x0B5) and again in Marco's rescue scene, where Carmen says the wedding is tomorrow; while set, the inn Keeper says it has already started, the square runs the ceremony (npc/2 actor 24) and villagers stand at their wedding spots. In Garam (npc/26, npc/27) it changes the Artema hall: the companion recalls Marco's kidnapping, the door stays locked until 0x0E6, a different cult member waits inside and the chest with Championo (item 1009) can open.

0x0AB.name: holy_armor_complete
0x0AB.summary: All four Holy Armor pieces found (Chapter 4)
0x0AB.detail: Chapter 4 "Last Battle" flag: set by whichever shrine chest (Holy Shield 0x099, Holy Helmet 0x09A, Holy Sword 0x09B, Holy Armor 0x09C) completes the set, with a quest line telling you to return to Darkbeat in Picard. While set, Darkbeat congratulates you and has you put on the armor (0x06E), Bonik's shop greeting changes (npc/35) and Rogo (npc/41) digs up Avalanche (item 1025) for you.
0x0AB.engine: Chapter 4 flag. The save/field-menu chapter title is the first of 0xAB, 0x9D, 0x86, 0xF9 that is set; 0xAB picks 'Last Battle'.

0x0AC.name: holy_dragon_fought
0x0AC.summary: Fought the Holy Dragon in her lair
0x0AC.detail: Set by any of the four Holy Dragon actors (npc/47, chunk 467) just before battle 0x111; if 0x095 is set she first accuses you of stealing her Stone. While set, the dragons are gone and a one-shot scene (guarded by 0x1FF) hands out the loot: D'Artagnan (item 1039), or two Spinach Snacks and item 506 if 0x095 is clear. Kalkanor at the Trisken castle party (npc/24) checks it to take your find and give D'Artagnan.

0x0AD.name: know_owl_told_switches
0x0AD.summary: Know Owl explained the four red switches
0x0AD.detail: Set the first time you talk to Know Owl in his home (npc/16, chunk 477); he says all four switches must be on to reach the heart of the castle. While set, he offers a free rest, and the red switches (0x0AE-0x0B1) can be turned on; before it they only get a puzzled look.

0x0AE.name: owl_castle_switch_1_on
0x0AE.summary: Red switch 1 of 4 turned on (Know Owl's castle)
0x0AE.detail: Set when you agree to turn on the first red switch (npc/16 actor 2, chunk 490), only after 0x0AD. The switch then says it is already on; when the fourth of 0x0AE-0x0B1 goes on the castle shakes and 0x0B2 is set.

0x0AF.name: owl_castle_switch_2_on
0x0AF.summary: Red switch 2 of 4 turned on (Know Owl's castle)
0x0AF.detail: Set when you agree to turn on the second red switch (npc/16 actor 3, chunk 490), only after 0x0AD. The switch then says it is already on; when the fourth of 0x0AE-0x0B1 goes on the castle shakes and 0x0B2 is set.

0x0B0.name: owl_castle_switch_3_on
0x0B0.summary: Red switch 3 of 4 turned on (Know Owl's castle)
0x0B0.detail: Set when you agree to turn on the third red switch (npc/16 actor 4, chunk 491), only after 0x0AD. The switch then says it is already on; when the fourth of 0x0AE-0x0B1 goes on the castle shakes and 0x0B2 is set.

0x0B1.name: owl_castle_switch_4_on
0x0B1.summary: Red switch 4 of 4 turned on (Know Owl's castle)
0x0B1.detail: Set when you agree to turn on the fourth red switch (npc/16 actor 5, chunk 491), only after 0x0AD. The switch then says it is already on; when the fourth of 0x0AE-0x0B1 goes on the castle shakes and 0x0B2 is set.

0x0B2.name: owl_castle_switches_all_on
0x0B2.summary: All four red switches on; the stuck door opens
0x0B2.detail: Set by whichever red switch (npc/16, chunks 490-491) completes 0x0AE-0x0B1, after a quake and "Did you hear that!?". While set, the switches say pushing again won't help, chunk 470 uses its alternate door set and the stuck-door actor in chunk 468 is removed, opening the way to the Holy Armor room.

0x0B3.name: gods_tower_anzo_beaten
0x0B3.summary: Beat the Anzo machine and took its item
0x0B3.detail: Anzo (npc/31 actor 7, chunk 516) greets the Baby, switches to Karmine's orders and fights you (battle 0x116, scratch 0x018 set first). After the battle the room trigger reruns Anzo, which gives Dark Cross (item 1011) and sets this flag; while set, Anzo is gone and the room's scene trigger stops.

0x0B4.name: gods_tower_lanzo_beaten
0x0B4.summary: Beat the Lanzo machine and took its item
0x0B4.detail: Lanzo (npc/31 actor 8, chunk 520) mentions Celestia, then logs in as Karmine's guard and fights you (battle 0x117, scratch 0x019 set first). After the battle the room trigger reruns Lanzo, which gives Holy Cross (item 1010) and sets this flag; while set, Lanzo is gone and the room's scene trigger stops.

0x0B5.name: garam_cult_hall_searched
0x0B5.detail: Set by either cult member inside the hall (npc/27, chunk 357): before 0x0A7 the lone worshipper says everyone left for God's Tower (or, with 0x0E6, is out preaching), and after it the 'mutating' member turns into a Gargoyle (battle 0x120). Cleared by the Isten Gargoyle scene (npc/3), so the hall gets its second visit. While set, the hall door (npc/26) only shows its sign before 0x0A7 or lets you straight in after it, a villager mentions banging then silence, and the Championo chest (item 1009) can open once 0x0A7 is set.

0x0B7.name: kuldo_winged_lion_fought
0x0B7.summary: Fought the Winged Lion in the Kuldo Ruins
0x0B7.detail: Set by the Winged Lion (npc/45 actor 5, chunk 431) just before battle 0x109, after Kalkanor's group takes the emerald and it cries "What have you done!?". While set, the Lion and its effect actors are gone. In Carmarthen (npc/12) a woman laughs at your claim of killing the beast instead of calling the Trisken group liars (shown only before 0x086).

0x0BA.name: alt_npc_set_active
0x0BA.summary: Alternate silent NPC set active (engine pack swap)
0x0BA.detail: No script sets or tests it in code; the engine sets it and, while it is set, loads silent Trisken pack npc/25 (every script empty) instead of npc/22 and gives chunk 188 the npc/0 pack. Placements show the same pattern: silent extras appear on overworld chunks (npc/0) and in npc/1 chunk 7 and npc/28 chunk 211 (where Shawn is removed), while the Kerple men, Ann in Garam and Bonik on npc/34 are fixed in place. This looks like a non-interactive tour such as the ending or a demo, but no script shows which.
0x0BA.engine: Set by the sky-flight scene (OVR24) on its second run, just before it starts battle 0x11D against Xizan; from then on the game is in its ending state. While set: Trisken uses NPC pack 25 instead of 22/21, chunk 188 gets its NPC pack, the overworld stops picking music by zone, the flight scene takes its third (ending) path, and the follower tasks are skipped there.

0x0BB.name: holy_sword_guardian_fought
0x0BB.summary: Fought the Guardian of the Holy Sword (Know Owl's castle)
0x0BB.detail: Set by the Guardian (npc/16 actor 7, chunk 492) just before battle 0x110, after saying you must prove yourself worthy of Darwin's armor. While set, the Guardian and four side actors are gone and the Holy Sword chest (item 52, flag 0x09B) moves into his spot; it disappears once 0x09B is set.

0x0BC.name: holy_armor_body_guardian_fought
0x0BC.summary: Fought the Guardian of the Holy Armor (body piece)
0x0BC.detail: Set by the Guardian (npc/43 actor 2, chunk 497) just before battle 0x10F, after saying its master is Darwin. While set, the Guardian and four side actors are gone and the Holy Armor body chest (item 106, flag 0x09C) moves into its spot; it disappears once 0x09C is set.

0x0BD.name: holy_helmet_guardian_fought
0x0BD.summary: Fought the Guardian of the Holy Helmet (Kerple ruins)
0x0BD.detail: Set by the Guardian (npc/19 actor 11, chunk 452) just before battle 0x10D, after asking if you are greater than Darwin. While set, the Guardian and four side actors are gone and the Holy Helmet chest (item 126, flag 0x09A) moves into its spot; it disappears once 0x09A is set.

0x0BE.name: holy_shield_guardian_fought
0x0BE.summary: Fought the Guardian of the Holy Shield
0x0BE.detail: Set by the Guardian (npc/46 actor 2, chunk 459) just before battle 0x10E, after saying it was built to protect this shield. While set, the Guardian and four side actors are gone and the Holy Shield chest (item 160, flag 0x099) moves into its spot; it disappears once 0x099 is set.

0x0BF.name: final_karmine_scene_hidden
0x0BF.detail: No script sets it; the engine does. Only npc/49 tests it: while set, Karmine, Darkbeat and two helpers are removed and a blank actor appears at (4500,-650). npc/49 holds the final-area scene where Darkbeat stays behind to fight Karmine, so the flag probably marks that scene as finished or not in use, but the scripts do not show when it is set.
0x0BF.engine: Set by the sky-flight scene (OVR24) on its first run, just before battle 0x102 (Darkbeat and Ibkee against Karmine in the sky). While set, the next run of that scene uses its second camera path, start point and music (0x238) and leads to the Xizan battle instead; the flight sparkles also sit lower.

0x0C0.name: orgo_destiny_dream_pending
0x0C0.summary: Dream of the man in the light is about to play
0x0C0.detail: Set with 0x097 when the Knight goes to bed after the Baby was left at the Cave of Fear (0x096): by the San Claria inn keeper (npc/5) or the Knight's bed at home in Orgo (npc/7). It places the '???' man in the light in Orgo (npc/6, chunk 78), whose scene tells the Knight to take the baby to its mother in God's Tower, then clears it and sets 0x081 and 0x01F.

0x0C1.name: trisken_cult_attack_repelled
0x0C1.summary: Trisken saved from the Artema Cult attack
0x0C1.detail: Set by Org, the cult leader in Trisken (npc/21), when you confront him after clearing all eight monster groups (scratch 0x001–0x008), just before battle 0x11A; the same script clears 0x0EF and 0x0F0. While set, Trisken's citizens and guards thank you, the Recruiter hands over item 1068, the attack Gargoyles and Org disappear, and the shops and inn (npc/23) reopen, the inn with a free room; npc/25 mirrors the same placements.
0x0C1.engine: Inlined bit test in the overworld music/hotspot task: on Trisken chunks 270–272, standing in map zone 0x0C while 0xE6 is set starts actor 35's scene ("The Artema Cult is attacking the city of Trisken!"), unless 0xC1 or 0xEF is set. So 0xC1 stops the Trisken raid from starting again.

0x0C2.name: mtc_sparring_match_booked
0x0C2.summary: Monster Training Center match chosen and pending
0x0C2.detail: No script sets it: the Trisken MTC clerk (npc/23) opens the opponent menu (shop 22) and starts sparring battle 0x124 only if it is set afterwards, so engine code sets it when an opponent is picked. While set, chunk 380 auto-runs the clerk's after-match lines, which clear it (and also 0x0F4 after a loss).
0x0C2.engine: Set by the training-course menu (shop 0x16, 'Train'): picking a monster and paying the Baby's level x 100 rubies stores the choice and sets 0xC2. The course clerk's trigger and script (npc/23) then run the fight and clear it.

0x0C3.name: credits_finished
0x0C3.summary: Ending credits played to the end
0x0C3.engine: Set every frame of the final fade-out of the ending credits fly-over (root mode 0x20), just before the game returns to the load screen. Nothing in the code or the scripts reads it.

0x0E6.name: xizan_unleashed
0x0E6.summary: Xizan unleashed; a giant worm haunts the skies
0x0E6.detail: Set at the top of God's Tower (npc/30) when the defeated Karmine calls on Xizan, God of Darkness; never cleared. While set, people everywhere talk about the giant flying worm, many extra NPCs vanish, the Kerple island scenes and the God's Tower summit trigger stop, and the engine loads npc/39 for Zed Harbor and npc/21 for Trisken, both under Artema Cult attack.
0x0E6.engine: While set (Karmine summons Xizan in npc/30), Zed Harbor (chunks 87/89) loads NPC pack 39 instead of 10 and Trisken loads pack 21 instead of 22. It also arms the hard-coded cult-raid scenes: zone 0x0E in Zed Harbor starts actor 42 and zone 0x0C in Trisken starts actor 35, unless 0xEF or 0x9E/0xC1 is set.

0x0EE.name: chained_scene_in_progress
0x0EE.summary: Scripted sequence spanning map changes in progress
0x0EE.detail: Set at the start of chained cutscenes that carry the party across warps and cleared once the player has control again: Marco's 'wedding is tomorrow' to the wedding party (npc/3 to npc/2), the sleeping bird near Kell to waking at Amos's inn (npc/40 to npc/1), the Zephyr nap and storm (npc/42 to Jungo or npc/18), and the God's Tower summit to Picard (npc/30 to npc/9). Scripts never test it; engine code reads it, so what it actually switches off is for the decomp notes.
0x0EE.engine: While set, the field HUD task skips the compass and the overworld minimap: they don't fade in, aren't drawn, and Select can't toggle the minimap. Scripts set it around sleeping, waking and other set-piece scenes.

0x0EF.name: cult_attack_in_progress
0x0EF.summary: Artema Cult attack on the town is under way
0x0EF.detail: Set with 0x0F0 when you arrive at Trisken (npc/21) or Zed Harbor (npc/39) during the attacks that follow Xizan's release; while set, Trisken's exit trigger makes the companion turn you back to help the Triskenians. Cleared when the ringleader is found: Org in Trisken (which sets 0x0C1) or the one Bosmie points out in Zed Harbor (which sets 0x09E).
0x0EF.engine: Inlined bit test: while set, the hard-coded raid scenes in Zed Harbor (actor 42, zone 0x0E) and Trisken (actor 35, zone 0x0C) don't start. Scripts set it together with 0xF0 when a raid begins and clear both when it ends.

0x0F0.name: town_besieged_by_cult
0x0F0.summary: Town under cult attack (engine-read twin of 0x0EF)
0x0F0.detail: Always set and cleared alongside 0x0EF in the same Trisken (npc/21) and Zed Harbor (npc/39) attack scenes; no script tests it. Engine code reads it, so it presumably changes field behaviour while a town is under attack; see the decomp notes.
0x0F0.engine: While set (with 0xEF, when the cult raids Trisken or Zed Harbor), map zones 12 and 14 report area/music id 3, battles there keep the field music instead of loading battle music, and battle entry doesn't stop the music. The Baby's Fly row is greyed too.

0x0F1.name: boss_event_active
0x0F1.summary: In a Warp Gate room or a scripted boss event
0x0F1.detail: The Warp Gate Key scripts (npc/16, 19, 43, 46) set it when they send the party into a Guardian's gate room and test it to send them back, clearing it. Boss and story scenes also set it at the start and clear it at the end: Ruval the Giant (npc/27), Gwinladin's betrayal (npc/37), the North Tower monsters and Guardian (npc/44), the God's Tower summit (npc/30, npc/31) and Darwin (npc/38). Engine code reads it too.
0x0F1.engine: While set, field-use Living Toys of kind 3 (the PP-costing escape toys, which only work where a return point is stored) are greyed out in the Living Toys menu. Scripts set it when the Warp Gate Key takes you into a Guardian chamber and in other no-escape sequences.

0x0F2.name: holy_armor_book_read
0x0F2.summary: Read the Book of Holy Armor in Picard
0x0F2.detail: Set (with scratch 0x004) when the Book of Holy Armor in Picard (npc/9) is read while 0x0A5 is clear; the book names the four resting places (Nord Temple, Kerple, Castle Ryan, Denime) and is followed by the world-map pins cutscene. No script tests it; engine code reads it.
0x0F2.engine: After a save is loaded, if 0xF2 is set the game reloads the later world-map pin texture (SYS05); otherwise it checks 0xF3. The script sets it when you read the Book of Holy Armor in the library (npc/9).

0x0F3.name: amos_magic_map_received
0x0F3.summary: Amos gave you Bonik's magic map
0x0F3.detail: Set by Amos at his riverside inn (npc/1) when he hands over item 1056, 'some kind of magic map' Bonik once gave him, right after the world-map pins cutscene. While set, the inn's bookshelves say Bonik forgot some of his books. Engine code also reads it.
0x0F3.engine: After a save is loaded, if 0xF3 (and not 0xF2) is set the game reloads the first world-map pin texture (SYS04); with neither, the map has no pins. Amos sets it (npc/1) when he hands over the thing Bonik left him, right as the pinned map texture is loaded.

0x0F4.name: lost_last_battle
0x0F4.summary: Lost the last training or test battle
0x0F4.detail: No script sets it (engine code does). After the Trisken Recruiter's test (battle 0x123, npc/22) and the MTC sparring match (battle 0x124, npc/23), the scripts check it to play the 'train more' or 'try again' lines instead of the reward, then clear it.
0x0F4.engine: Set when you lose a battle you are allowed to lose: battle 0x123 (the Trisken recruiter's test) or the Baby-only training fight (arena 0x124). Instead of game over the game continues (mode 0x10; a win with the Knight knocked out also sets it), and the recruiter (npc/22) and course clerk (npc/23) test and clear it.

0x0F5.name: talking_companion_away
0x0F5.summary: Talking companion ($C) is away from the Knight
